Prerequisite 2: Adept Focus or Intuition
At-Will - Free Action
Target: An Enemy within 10 m
Effect: The Target becomes Marked with a Tagged Mark. 
The Tagged Mark has no effect other than applying to the 
Momentum Counter Mechanic. 
Trainers that are a Duelist are experts in your standard, typical 
Pokemon battles. They excel in singling down enemies and taking them 
down, then moving onto the next Enemy until none stand in their way. 
As time progresses in a battle, Momentum makes them even stronger.
DUELIST
Mechanic - Momentum Counters
Your Pokemon can have a Maximum of 6 Momentum Counters. At the end 
of each Round, your Pokemon gain +1 Momentum Counter. Whenever your 
Pokemon hit a Tagged Enemy with an Attack or Maneuver, they gain +1 
Momentum. Whenever your Pokemon miss a Tagged Enemy, they lose -1 
Momentum. Whenever your Pokemon Faint, are Recalled, or end Combat, all 
Momentum Counters are lost. Your Pokemon have a Bonus to Accuracy and 
Evasion against Tagged Enemies equal to their Momentum Counters.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.59)

5959
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes

Prerequisite: Mastermind, Novice Guile or Intuition

7 or lower or has an EOT or At-Will Frequency, 
the Triggering Attack has the Sureshot Keyword. 
Otherwise, all applicable Targets cannot apply Stat 
Evasion against the Triggering Attack.

Status Attack

Temporary Hit Points

Cunning Wit
Prerequisite: Mastermind, Adept Guile or Intuition
Static
Effect: At the Start of each Round, you gain a Wit Counter 
(Max 3). You or your Pokemon may expend a Wit Counter at 
any time to gain an additional Swift Action or Reaction, which 
is removed at the end of the Round. A Combatant can only 
expend a Wit Counter once per Round.
Devious Training
Prerequisite: Mastermind, 3 Mastermind Features, Master

[Advanced] [Class]

Mastermind Trainers are always one step ahead of their enemies. As 
such, their Pokemon are trained specifically to exploit their enemies’ 
weaknesses, directed by the mastermind themselves. These Trainers 
specialize in status moves compared to direct damaging attacks. 
MASTERMIND

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.60)
body:
6060
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
Artist: Unknown
STAT ACE
While some Trainers specialize by a favored type of Pokemon, some 
Trainers just like Pokemon that excel in a certain stat. This could be 
bulky defenisve walls like Golem and Bastiodon or it could be swift 
Pokemon like Yanmega and Weavile. 
Stat Ace
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Training Specialist [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Poke Edu or an Adept Stat Skill
Static 
Effect: Choose Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special 
Defense, Speed or HP to become your linked Stat. Your 
Pokemon gain the Ability listed in parenthesis next to your 
Linked Stat.

• Attack (Huge Power), Defense (Stoicism), Special Attack 
(Sorcery), Special Defense (Mysticism), Speed (Alacrity), HP 
(Abominable) 
Stat Training
Prerequisite: Stat Ace, Adept Poke Edu or an Adept Stat 
Skill
At-Will - Extended Action 
Trigger: You perform a Training Downtime Action on 
your Pokemon
Effect: Your Trained Pokemon learns an Attack listed 
below based on your chosen Stat even if they cannot 
normally learn it or may swap one of their Attacks 
learned this way with another listed Attack under the 
chosen Stat. This Attack does not take an Attack Slot on 
their Battle Attack List.
 

• HP: Recover, Refresh

• Attack: Swords Dance, Feint 

• Defense: Iron Defense, Reflect

• Special Attack: Nasty Plot, Hidden Power

• Special Defense: Amnesia, Light Screen

• Speed: Agility, After You 
Stat Mastery
Prerequisite: Stat Ace, 2 Stat Ace Features, Expert Poke 
Edu or an Expert Stat Skill
Static 
Effect: Your Pokemon gain an Ability based on your 
chosen Stat:

• HP: Vigor

• Attack: Defiant

• Defense: Stamina

• Special Attack: Mental Force

• Special Defense: Magic Guard

• Speed: Accelerate
Stat Link
Prerequisite: Stat Ace, Novice Poke Edu or a 
Novice Stat Skill
Static 
Effect: Your Pokemon have their Default CS for their linked Stat 
set to +1 CS. If the Stat is HP , they instead start the Scene with 2 
Ticks of Temporary hit Points. At the end of your Pokemon’s Turn, 
if their linked Stat is below their Default CS value, it is set to their 
Default CS value. If the Stat is HP , at the end of their Turn if their 
Hit Points are below 50%, they restore a Tick of Hit Points. 
Stat Specialty
Prerequisite: Stat Ace, 3 Stat Ace Features, 
Master Poke Edu or a Master Stat Skill
Scene x 2 - Swift Action
Effect: This Feature’s Effect is dependent on your 
Linked Stat.

• HP: You may Target your Pokemon within 5 m to have them 
restore 3 Ticks of Hit Points or have them be cured of a Status 
Affliction. A Pokemon can only be Targeted this way once per 
Scene. 

• Attack: You may Target your Pokemon within 5 m to have their 
next Physical Attack treat its range as “Melee, Pass” or “Melee, 
All Adjacent Enemies”. This Attack ignores any positive Combat 
Stages in Defense. 

• Defense: You may Trigger this Feature when your Pokemon are 
hit by a Special Attack to instead apply Defense towards Damage 
Calculations.

• Special Attack: You may Target your Pokemon within 5 m to 
have their next Special Attack treat its range as “4, 2 Targets” 
or “8, Ranged Blast 3”. This Attack ignores any positive Combat 
Stages in Special Defense. 

• Special Defense: You may Trigger this Feature when your 
Pokemon are hit by a Physical Attack to instead apply Special 
Defense towards Damage Calculations.

• Speed: You may Trigger this Feature when your Pokemon make 
an Attack to have them ignore Speed Evasion. If it’s Damaging, 
Targets must use their Speed Stat instead of the relevant Defense 
Stat to determine the Damage Calculations.
Note - Each Skill has an associated Stat which also may be used to 
qualify for Stat Ace Features. Attack (Athletics or Combat), Defense 
(Athletics or Focus), Special Attack (Occult Edu or Focus), Special 
Defense (Occult Edu or Focus), Speed (Acrobatics or Combat), HP 
(Athletics or Focus)

Expert Command or Intimidate

Temporary Hit Points.

Pokemon can only benefit from this Feature once per Scene

Hardened Expectations
Prerequisite: Taskmaster, 3 Taskmaster Features, Master 
Command or Intimidate
Scene x 2 - Special 
Trigger: Your Pokemon would be hit by an Attack, would fail a 
Save Check or hit an Attack
Effect: When Triggered, your Pokemon must use a Reaction to 
activate this Feature. If the Trigger was being hit by an Attack,

Taskmaster
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Commander or Training Specialist [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Command or Intimidate
Static 
Effect: Your Pokemon gain the listed benefits if their Current 
HIt Points are lower than the following HP Thresholds.
75% - +2 Modifier to Accuracy Rolls and Save Checks

0% - All the previous values are doubled.
Trainers dont’ always treat their Pokemon as friends. Taskmasters 
are trainers that tend to be more brutal when training their Pokemon. 
Whether its treating them as tools rather than companions or treating 
them with tough love, Taskmasters tend to be outliers as Trainers.
TASKMASTER

title: Edu or Poke Edu
body:
Note - Your Ranger Skills are - Charm, Command, Intuition, Nature 
Edu or Poke Edu
Mechanic - Companion
Pokemon that are your Companion are not considered to be 
captured but follow you and take orders as if they were captured. 
These Pokemon do not need Stat Sheets and cannot participate 
in Combat unless otherwise stated. Companion Pokemon are not 
counted towards your limit of 3 Pokemon in a Party but you may 
only have one Companion at a time unless otherwise stated. When 
a Pokemon loses the Companion Title they cannot assist the Party 
in any way and are treated as a Wild Pokemon that cannot become 
a Companion again, and may either choose to follow the Players to 
be later captured with a Pokeball or return to their home and leave 
the Scene. A Pokemon loses the Companion Title whenever they 
do any of the following: 

•  They use a Capability

•  They succeed a Skill Check that assists the Party

•  They are dismissed by the Trainer

•  A Downtime Phase would occur

[Ranked 3]

Some Trainers have a special connection with Pokemon, either being

title: Mechanic - Battle Companion
body:
Mechanic - Battle Companion
Battle Companions are treated as normal Companions but may be 
used in Battle and are treated as an Active Pokemon, despite not 
having a Stat Sheet. Battle Companions can only use your Trainer 
Actions that you expend through the Officer Feature for Actions, 
unlike normal Pokemon. Other than that, when they gain Initiative 
they may move up to 3 m without expending a Movement Action. 
A Battle Companion is considered to have access to all Attacks 
on their Level-Up List at or below your Max Pokemon Level. If a 
Battle Companion would use a Damaging Attack, its Offensive Stat 
is equal to Triple your Tier Value. When your Battle Companion is 
targeted by a Damaging Attack, roll a Luck Check with a TN 5. If 
they fail, they Faint and lose their Companion Title. Every time a 
Battle Companion succeeds this Check, increase the TN by +5.
6464
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
Coordinated Assistance
Prerequisite: Officer, Novice Combat or Command
At-Will - Reaction
Trigger: An Ally fails a Save Check or Accuracy Check
Target: Your Pokemon or Battle Companion that is 
Adjacent to the Triggering Ally
Effect: The Triggering Ally may reroll with a modifier 
equal to your Tier Level. 
You’re Under Arrest!
[Order]
Prerequisite: Officer, Expert Combat or Command
At-Will - Swift Action
Target: Your Pokemon or Battle Companion within 3 m 
and an Enemy within 3 m of them
Effect: The Targeted Pokemon performs an AC 4 
Status Attack against the Targeted Enemy. If it hits, 
apply one of the following Effects to the Targeted 
Enemy:

• They become Grappled and you have Dominance

• They become Slowed

• They become Trapped 
Combat Assist
Prerequisite: Officer, Adept Combat or Command
Scene x 2 - Swift Action 
Target: Your Battle Companion within 5 m
Effect: Choose an Attack from the Poke Assist Chart (See: 
Ranger) that matches one of the Target’s Types. They use that 
Attack immediately as a Free Action. 
Companion Commander
Prerequisite: 4 Officer Features, Master Combat or Command 
Scene x 2 - Full Action 
Target: Two Battle Companions within 2 m of you
Effect: Both Targets may use an At-Will or Eo T Damaging 
Attack as a Free Action. If both Attacks only Target the same 
single Enemy, they both have the Sureshot Keyword
Bonus: Once per Round, when using Officer Features, you 
may Target an Allied Pokemon as if they were your Battle 
Companion. 
Officer
[Advanced] [Class]
Prerequisite 1: Ranger [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Combat or Command
Bind X - Standard or Extended Action
Target: Your Companion 
Effect: While Bound, the Companion becomes a Battle 
Companion. If they were to gain Initiative, you may expend any 
number of unused Trainer Actions for them to use, otherwise 
they cannot use Actions. When you Faint, this Feature is 
unbound and they lose their Companion Title. X is equal to your 
Tier Level. 
Bonus: You gain a Ranger Styler.
Rangers that are more authoritative tend to follow the path of an 
Officer, the law enforcement in most settings. These Characters 
handle combat against villains and aggressive Pokemon and are able 
to command their Companions to assist in battle!
OFFICER

title: GM Note
body:
GM Note
Throughout the Campaign as rewards, allow your 
Ranger to learn new Styler Mods and ways to 
utilize their gadgets and styler! Depending on your 
setting, different tech could be useful so allow your 
Players to get creative. In a Shadow Campaign you 
could possibly have a Styler Gadget to determine if 
something is a Shadow.
6565
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
Styler Gadgetry
Prerequisite: Operator, Adept Tech Edu
At-Will - Extended Action
Effect: Styler Gadgetry can only be activated by using a Downtime Action. 
Choose a Gadget below to apply to your Ranger Styler. A Styler can only 
benefit from one Gadget at a time unless you have 5 Operator or Ranger 
Features, then you can benefit from two instead. You can unlock new 
Gadgets to apply to your Ranger Styler as a Downtime Innovate Action at 
your GM’s discretion. 

• Aura Scanner - While equipped, you gain the Aura Reader Capability. 
Instead of you seeing Aura however, you must wave the Styler while 
adjacent to the target and it will expose their Aura for everyone to see. 

• Electro-Link - While Equipped, you have a Boon to all Skill Checks 
involved with identifying and manipulating technology. At your GM’s 
discretion, this Gadget may allow the holder to perform different technical 
actions like hacking a machine they’ve analyzed or interfering with it in 
some way such as disabling its functions. 

• Holo Projector - While equipped, you gain the Illusionist Capability. 
However, any Illusions created this way are holographic in nature and are 
obvious for most creatures to discern. 

• Ranger Beacon - When installed, choose a group of willing Allies who also 
have Ranger Stylers. While equipped, you may share any of the following 
to this group via your Styler, regardless of distance. Data Transfer, Verbal 
Communication, Video Information, Health Status of Creatures.
Advanced Module
Prerequisite: Activate Module, Master Tech Edu
Scene - Free Action 
Condition: You have a Ranger Styler equipped
Effect: Apply a Styler Mod to your Ranger Styler. Your Styler can only 
benefit from one Styler Mod at a time. 
Bonus: Your Styler Mods have their Effects improved based on having this 
Feature.
Activate Module!
Prerequisite: Operator, Novice Tech 
Edu
At-Will - Swift or Movement Action 
Condition: You have a Ranger Styler 
equipped
Effect: Apply a Styler Mod on the next 
page to your Ranger Styler. Your Styler 
can only benefit from one Styler Mod 
at a time and Mods are removed at the 
end of the Scene. 
Zone Control
Prerequisite: Operator, Expert Tech Edu
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Effect: Choose an Effect to Apply:

• The next time you use a Ranger 
Styler’s Effect, if you used it as a Swift 
Action, you may target enemies in a 
2 x 2 Zone instead of one within 5 m. If 
you used it as a Standard Action, you 
may instead target enemies in a 3 x 3 
Zone. 

• The next Weapon Attack you use 
through your Ranger Styler has its Area 
of Effect increased by +1 or is treated 
as Ranged Blast 2. 
Operator
[Advanced] [Class]
Prerequisite 1: Ranger or Tech Researcher [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Tech Edu
Static 
Effect: While your Ranger Styler occupies an Equipment Slot, 
it is treated as a Simple, Short Ranged Martial Weapon. Its 
qualifying skill is Technology Education. At Tier 2, it improves 
to Fine Quality and at Tier 3, it improves to Legendary 
Quality. You may choose the granted Attacks but it does not 
get Keywords. 
Bonus: You gain a Ranger Styler.
Officers and other Rangers need to get their gadgets and equipment 
from somewhere, and that calls for Operators! Operators excel in 
utilization of the Ranger Styler and can adjust it in various ways to 
always have an advantage in their combat missions!
OPERATOR

apply.

Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes

title: Note - A Mounted Pokemon does not need to be physically
body:
Note - A Mounted Pokemon does not need to be physically 
ridden to benefit from Rider Features.
GM Note - A Mounted Pokemon does not need to be physically 
ridden to benefit from Rider Features. 
It could simply be moving close in unison, however the typical 
intent is for Pokemon like Arcanine to be ridden. Alternatively you 
could create custom shapped saddles similar to how the Machamp 
ride mechanic works in alola. Smaller Pokemon like Pichu can  
also ride on the Trainer’s shoulder or run alongside them in the  
same occupying space to functionally have the same effects  
as being ridden. 
Rider Examples 
1. A Rider has his ace Pokemon as a Charizard and mounts it in battle to fly 
around and command him from the sky.
2. A Rider who is also a skirmisher battles alongside his Excavalier side by 
side, slicing their targets with precision.
3. A Rider carries a Smoliv in their backpack and protects it as they fight.
6767
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
Sometimes Rangers specialize in riding Pokemon or act alongside 
their partners. Riders specialize in acting in unison with their 
Pokemon, defending one another, retaliating for one another and 
battling as a synchronized unit, even during dire situations. 
Rider
[Advanced] [Class]
Prerequisite 1: Ranger or Training Specialist [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Acrobatics or Athletics
Static 
Effect: Your Pokemon are all treated as having the Mountable 
Capability. When Mounting a Pokemon, it may be performed as 
a Free Action instead of a Swift Action. While you are Mounted, 
you and your Mount each use the highest of each other’s 
Evasion when either are Targeted by an Attack.
RIDER
Cavalier’s Reprisal
Prerequisite: Rider, Novice Acrobatics or Athletics
Static
Effect: Whenever you’re hit by an Adjacent Attack, the 
Pokemon you’re mounting may Trigger their Attack 
of Opportunity against the Attacker. Whenever the 
Pokemon you’re mounting is hit by an Adjacent Attack, 
you may Trigger an Attack of Opportunity against 
the Attacker. These occur after the Triggering Attack 
resolves. If you’re both a Target, only one may Trigger 
an Attack of Opportunity this way.
Strafing Maneuver
Prerequisite: Rider, 2 Rider Features, Expert 
Acrobatics or Athletics
Scene - Special
Trigger: You and your Mount would be hit with a 
Blast, Burst or Line Attack 
Effect: This Feature requires a Reaction to be used by 
either you or your Mounted Pokemon. You both Slide 
any number of spaces, with the maximum amount 
being half the Movement Value of your Mounted 
Pokemon. The Triggering Attack then misses you both. 
Ride as One
Prerequisite: Rider, Adept Acrobatics or Athletics
Scene - Free Action 
Trigger: You or your Mounted Pokemon Intercept an Attack 
directed at one or the other
Effect: The Interceptor resists the Attack by an additional 
damage step.
Bonus: You and your Mounted Pokemon may Intercept for one 
another as a Movement Action if desired. When Intercepting 
for each other, the Attack isn’t increased by one damage step
Synchronized Strike
Prerequisite: Rider, 3 Rider Features, Master Acrobatics or 
Athletics
At-Will - Full Action 
Effect: The Pokemon you’re mounting may use a Damaging 
Attack as a Free Action, however it must target an Enemy 
they haven’t Targeted this Round yet. They cannot Attack those 
Targets for the rest of the Round.
Bonus: You and your Mounted Pokemon may expend SP from 
each other’s SP Pool, as if it were their own.

title: Pokemon or a Pokemon with mythological importance to
body:
GM Note - A Pokemon with significant power could be a Legendary 
Pokemon or a Pokemon with mythological importance to 
your setting such as an elder Venusaur that rules a forest. It is 
recommended that when your Player takes Signer, they have at 
least 1 Pokemon they have a bond with from their Backstory. They 
are meant to gain more as they journey which can expand what 
they can do and who they choose to draw power from at a given 
time. 
6868
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
SIGNER
Some Rangers are able to form deep connections with Legendaries 
and Pokemon of grand power. These Trainers may draw on their 
connections and form sigils which draw upon the power of these 
Guardians and can assist them or act on behalf of the Guardian.
Guardian Sign
Prerequisite: Signer, Novice Occult Edu or Poke Edu
At-Will - Standard Action
Effect: Choose a Guardian Sign from the list on the 
next page and apply its effects.
Battle Emblem
Prerequisite: Guardian Sign, Expert Occult Edu or 
Poke Edu
At-Will - Swift Action
Effect: Choose a Guardian Sign from the list on the 
next page and apply its effects. Each time you use this 
Feature after the first time during an Encounter, you 
must expend 1 additional SP to do so. (First usage is 0 
Points, next is 1, next is 2, etc…) 
Bonus: You may use the Signer Feature as a Swift 
Action twice per Day, choosing a new Target to 
become your Guardian. 
Guardian Aspect
Prerequisite: Signer, Adept Occult Edu or Poke Edu
Static
Effect: At any time, you can expend 1 SP to use a Guardian 
Aspect from the list on the next page and apply its effects. If 
used during combat it is considered a Free Action. Whenever 
you perform a Downtime Action involving one of your 
Guardians, you gain SP equal to half the number of Successes 
(Rounded Down)
Divine Intervention
Prerequisite: Guardian Sign, Master Occult Edu or Poke Edu
Scene x 2 - Reaction
Trigger: You or an Ally fall below 50% of their Maximum Hit 
Points 
Effect: Choose a Guardian Sign from the list on the next page 
and apply its effects to the triggering combatant. They also 
have a +2 bonus to Accuracy Checks and Save Checks until 
the end of their next Turn. 
Signer
[Advanced] [Class]
Prerequisite 1: Ranger or Occult Researcher [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Occult Edu or Poke Edu
Bind X - Extended Action 
Target: A Pokemon with significant power that you have at 
least a Trusted Bond with 
Effect: The Target becomes your Guardian for the duration 
they are bound by this Feature. 
Bonus: You may communicate with your Guardian(s) as if you 
had the Telepath and Empath Capability, regardless of your 
current distance from them. X is equal to your Tier Level.
Example (Gaining Spirit Points) - A Player has a Guardian Darkrai 
and at night, he spends a Downtime Action to perform relaxation. 
He meditates in his room and communicates to Darkrai through 
telepathy and updates them on their journey thus far . He regains  
2 SP as a result.

title: Guardian Aspects
body:
Guardian Aspects
Sigil of Authority
Effect: Whenever you fail a Skill Check involving a 
Pokemon whose Type matches one of your Guardians, 
you may use this Aspect to reroll it. This Aspect may 
only be performed once per Skill Check.
Sigil of Connection
Effect: This Aspect may be used to have one of your 
Guardians assist you in some way that they are 
currently able. You must be within their domain of 
influence for this to work or what you ask of them 
must be within their power profile. Depending on 
the scope of how they help, you may need to expend 
more than one Spirit Points. This cannot be used 
during Combat. 
Example (Forest Elder) - A Player has a Guardian of an Elder 
Venusaur . While running away from a group of Team Rocket, 
they use Sigil Connection to have Venusaur summon ivy 
that tangles their pursuers. A Player has a Guardian Xerneas. 
When encountering a Poisoned Audino in the wild, they call 
upon Xerneas to cure them, however it costs 2 Spirit Points. 
Sigil of Insight
Effect: Whenever you perform a Skill Check that one 
of your Guardians is Proficient or Mastered Rank in, 
you may use this Aspect to gain a Boon for it. 
Sigil of Symbiosis
Effect: When this Aspect is used, choose one of your 
Guardians. For up to 10 minutes, either you or the 
chosen Guardian may spiritually enter the willing 
other’s body, as if they shared a consciousness. While 
in this state, they experience all senses of the body 
they entered. If either participant takes damage for 
this duration, the connection is severed. 
Example (Forest Elder) - A Player has a Guardian of an Elder 
Venusaur . While traveling, the Player is telepathically made 
aware that someone is attacking the forest, they set up a 
Sigil of Symbiosis and the Player connects with Venusaur, 
seeing a group of Team Rocket attacking native Pokemon 
and setting up fires. 
Sigil of Unity
Effect: Choose a Capability that one of your Guardians 
has. You gain that Capability until the end of the Day. 
Guardian Signs
Sigil of Elements
Effect: Choose an Attack that you or an Ally within 
5 m knows and a Type that one of your Guardians is. 
The Attack is treated as that Type until the end of the 
Scene. 
Sigil of Empowerment
Effect: Choose you or an Ally within 5 m and one of 
your Guardians. The chosen combatant gains +2 CS in 
any Stat, or +1 CS in your Guardian’s highest base stat 
if used as a Swift Action.
Sigil of Imbuement
Effect: Choose you or an Ally within 5 m and one of 
your Guardians. The chosen combatant gains one 
Attack the Guardian can learn until the end of the 
Scene, provided the combatant could legally learn it 
through Tutor Rules. 
Sigil of Protection
Effect: Choose you or an Ally within 5 m. The chosen 
Combatant gains 2 Ticks of Temporary Hit points. If 
used as a Standard Action, they also resist all attacks 
by an additional damage step until the start of your 
next Turn. 
Sigil of Restoration
Effect: Choose you or an Ally within 5 m. If used as a 
Standard Action, the chosen combatant restores 5 
Ticks of Hit Points or is cured of a Status Affliction. 
Otherwise, they restore 2 Ticks of Hit Points and have 
a +2 bonus to their next Save Check. A Combatant can 
only benefit from the Standard Action effect once per 
Scene. 
 
 
6969
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
GM Note
Whenever a Player develops their relationship with one of 
their Guardians, you should encourage new Signs or Aspects 
to be discovered depending on the fluff of the Guardian, 
as these are meant to be generic and usable across an 
assortment of entities! This should be given as rewards for 
invested time or success. An example could be that a Player 
with a Guardian Ho-Oh can use a special Sign once per 
Scene known as the Sigil of Revival, which allows them to 
revive a Combatant and set them to 2 Ticks of Hit Points if 
used as a Standard Action. Another example could be a Sigil 
of Nightmares, allowing a Player to cause a Drowsy Enemy 
to become Cursed.

TYPE SPECIALIST
Between Gym Leaders and Trainers who just prefer certain types, Type 
Specialist is the class meant for those who love a specific type. While 
some specialists may run only one type on their team, these classes allow 
you to use other Pokemon whie boosting their ability to use that type.
Type Specialist 
[Base] [Class]
Prerequisite: 1 Pokemon of your Chosen Type. Type Linked 
Skill or Poke Edu at Novice
Static 
Effect: Choose a Type to become your Chosen Type. You gain 
the Type Aura Ability. “Your Type” for Type Aura is considered 
to be your chosen Type. Your Pokemon always benefit from 
your Type Aura Feature regardless of if they’re within 2 m of 
you. 
Note: If you qualify for this Feature through Poke Edu, you 
may choose any Type, otherwise it must meet the Skill 
Requirements associated with that Type. 
Type Sync
Prerequisite: Type Specialist, Type Linked Skill or Poke 
Edu at Novice
At-Will - Free Action 
Trigger: An Allied Pokemon within 5 m uses an Attack
Effect: The Triggering Attack’s is treated as your 
chosen Type instead. This may cause the Attack to 
Trigger Features as if your chosen Type was its Natural 
Type, ignoring normal rules. 
Type Exploit
Prerequisite: Type Specialist, Type Linked Skill or Poke 
Edu at Expert
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon hit with an Attack of your 
chosen Type
Effect: The Attack is resisted one step less, to a 
maximum of neutral effectiveness. If the Target(s) 
were to be Immune to the Triggering Attack, it instead 
becomes neutral effectiveness.
Type Expertise
Prerequisite: Type Specialist, Type Linked Skill or Poke Edu at 
Adept
Scene - Free Action
Trigger: You or an Ally within 5 m are hit with a Damaging 
Attack that matches your chosen Type.
Effect: You and all Allies targeted by the Triggering Attack 
resist it by an additional damage step. 
Bonus: You treat your chosen Type as resisted whenever 
you’re Attacked by a Damaging Attack that matches it. 
Type Embodiment
Prerequisite: Type Specialist, 3 Type Specialist Features, Type 
Linked Skill or Poke Edu at Master
Bind 3 - Extended Action 
Target: Your Pokemon
Effect: While Bound, the Target’s Type is adjusted in order 
to include your chosen Type. Adjusting this way can either 
replace a Type for your chosen Type, or add the Type if they 
only have one Type. If a Type is replaced, all of the Target’s 
Attacks that are the replaced Type instead become your 
chosen Type (For example, Thunderbolt becoming Fire Type). 
Once this Feature is bound, it cannot be unbound outside of 
GM discretion.

title: Reactive Adaptation
body:
7171
Reactive Adaptation
Prerequisite: Bug Specialist, Command, Nature Edu or 
Poke Edu at Novice
Scene x 2 - Reaction
Trigger: Any Combatant would perform a Roll
Target: Your Pokemon bound by the Bug Specialist 
Feature
Effect: Tefore the Trigger resolves, the Target switches 
an Adaptation Technique they’re currently affected by 
with a different Technique. This change reverts at the 
end of the Scene
Transitory Improvement
Prerequisite: Bug Specialist, Command, Nature Edu or 
Poke Edu at Expert
At-Will - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Bug Type Pokemon start their Turn
Effect: The Triggering Pokemon gains a +2 Modifier to 
one of the following Combat Values until the end of 
the Round.

• Accuracy, Effect Range, Critical Hit, 
Evasion, Save Checks
Advanced Evolution
Prerequisite: Bug Specialist, Command, Nature Edu or Poke 
Edu at Adept
Scene x 2 - Free Action
Trigger: Your Pokemon begins their Turn
Effect: During this Turn, your Pokemon’s Bug Type Damaging 
Attacks can have their Range altered to any of the following 
until the end of the Turn.

• If Melee: It can become Pass, Burst 1 or Close Blast 2

• If Ranged 1-Target: It can become Line 4 or Ranged Blast 2
Disruptive Pest
Prerequisite: Bug Specialist, 3 Bug Specialist Features, 
Command, Nature Edu or Poke Edu at Master
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon hit a Bug Type Attack
Effect: After the Attack’s resolution, choose an Effect to apply 
to all Targets of the Triggering Attack. An Enemy can only be 
affected by Disruptive Pest once per Scene.

• They lose -2 CS in all Stats they have positive CS in.

• They fail their next Save Check.

• They become Dazed and suffer -3 to their next 
Accuracy Roll.
Bug Specialist
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Type Specialist (Bug as your chosen Type) [or]
Prerequisite 2: Command, Nature Edu or Poke Edu at Adept
Bind 3 - Extended Action
Target: Your Pokemon with a Bug Type Attack
Effect: Choose an Adaptation Technique to apply to the 
Targeted Pokemon which they benefit from while this Feature 
is Bound. Your Pokemon can only have one Adaptation at a 
time. 

• Adaptation Techniques are on the next Page
Bug Specialists excel in training Pokemon that are insectoids in nature. 
Compared to normal Trainers, Bug Specialists specialize in unlocking 
the adaptive nature of Bug Types, being able to command temporarily 
evolutionary forms depending on what they need in combat.

title: Chitin Shield
body:
Chitin Shield
Effect: The user has an Uncapped bonus to Evasion 
equal to your Tier Level against Status Attacks. If the 
user is Targeted by an Attack, the Attack has a penalty 
to Effect Ranges and Critical Hit Ranges equal to your 
Tier Level.
Exoskeleton
Effect: The user has Damage Reduction against 
Physical Attacks equal to your Tier Value
Nimble Speed
Effect: The user has a bonus to their Movement Value 
equal to double your Tier Level and cannot provoke 
Attacks of Opportunity via movement. 
Venomous Glands
Effect: The user’s Damaging Attacks have a 16+ Effect 
Range to Poison all Targets hit by the Attack. This 
extends existing Poison Effect Ranges by +2. The user 
may use any Bug Type Attack as if it were Poison Type. 
Piercing Power
Effect: The user’s Bug Type Attacks cannot be resisted 
by Type Effectiveness. The user ignores Damage 
Reduction equal to your Tier Value. 
Predator Senses
Effect: The user can sense when an Enemy is 50% HP 
or lower. The user’s Bug Type and Melee Attacks have 
the Sureshot Keyword when Attacking Enemies that 
have less than 50% HP or have a Status Affliction. 
Strength Sapper
Effect: Whenever the user hits an Attack against a 
single Enemy used as a Standard Action, they lose 
-2 CS in a Stat of your choice. On a 14+, they gain +1 
CS in the chosen Stat or gain a Tick of Temporary Hit 
Points. On a 19+, they instead gain +2 CS or two Ticks 
of Temporary HP .
Swarm Commander
Effect: Allies that Attack an Enemy the user is 
Adjacent to have a bonus to Accuracy Rolls equal to 
your Tier Level. Once per Round, an Ally within 3 m 
can use an Intercept on an Attack Targeting the user 
as a Free Action.

Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
DARK SPECIALIST
Dark Specialists excel in training Pokemon that tend to be either 
aggressive or sly in nature, as Dark Types tend to be. Whether it’s a 
mischevious Pokemon like Morgrem or an aggressive Pokemon like 
Pangoro, these specialists excel in dark type and social attacks. 
Dark Specialist
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Type Specialist (Dark as your chosen Type) [or]
Prerequisite 2: Guile, Poke Edu or Stealth at Adept
Static 
Effect: Your Pokemon have a bonus to Accuracy equal to your 
Tier Level if the Target is Flanked, Drowsy, Slowed, Suppressed, 
Tripped, Weakened or Vulnerable. If the Attack is Dark Type and 
they gain this bonus, they also have a bonus to Effect Ranges 
equal to your Tier Level. 
Clever Ruse
Prerequisite: Dark Specialist, Guile, Poke Edu or 
Stealth at Novice
At-Will - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon hit a Dark Type Attack against 
an Enemy
Effect: After the Triggering Attack resolves choose an 
Effect belowhoose an Effect below to apply. Clever 
Ruse can only be activated once per Round:

• Targets of the Triggering Attack lose -1 CS in a Stat 
of your choice.

• They may use a Manipulate Maneuver against one 
Target as a Free Action

• Targets of the Triggering Attack have a Penalty to 
their next Save Check equal to your Tier Level.
Devious
Prerequisite: Dark Specialist, Guile, Poke Edu or 
Stealth at Expert
Scene - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Dark Type Pokemon use an Attack with 
the Social Keyword
Effect: After the Triggering Attack is resolved, they 
immediately use a Dark Type Status Category Attack 
or a different Attack with the Social Keyword as a 
Swift Action. This Attack must have a different Target 
than the Triggering Attack.
Sly Scheme 
Prerequisite: Dark Specialist, Guile, Poke Edu or Stealth 
at Adept
At-Will - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon resolve a Dark Type or Status Attack
Effect: Choose an Effect below to apply to the Triggering 
Pokemon. Sly Scheme can only be activated once per Round 
and cannot be used if you used Clever Ruse for the Triggering 
Attack:

• They may use the Disengage Maneuver as a Free Action

• They gain +1 CS to a Stat of their choice

• Their next Attack or Maneuver ignores Stat Evasion
Master Plan
Prerequisite: Dark Specialist, 3 Dark Specialist Features, 
Guile, Poke Edu or Stealth at Master
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon hit a Maneuver (With an AC) or Dark 
Type Status Attack against a single Enemy 
Effect: After the Triggering Attack or Maneuver resolves 
choose an Effect belowhoose an Effect below to apply to the 
Enemy. An Enemy can only be affected by Master Plan once 
per Scene.

• The Target fails their next Save Check

• The Target has a Stat with Positive CS set to -2 CS

• The Target has all Abilities or an Attack you’ve witnessed 
Disabled until the end of the next Round.
