Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
Unyielding Spirit
Prerequisite: Dragon Specialist, Command, Intimidate 
or Poke Edu at Novice
Scene x 2 - Special
Trigger: Your Pokemon become Enraged or fall below 
50% Hit Points
Effect: This Feature can be activated as a Reaction 
by your Pokemon when the Trigger would occur. The 
Triggering Pokemon has a Status Affliction they’re 
affected by cured or remove a Coat that is affecting 
them. Whenever they Trigger this Feature, their next 
Damaging Attack gains the Smite Keyword
Bonus: While your Pokemon are below 50% Hit 
Points, their Dragon Type Damaging Attacks have the 
Smite Keyword, or Sureshot Keyword if they already 
have the Smite Keyword. 
Empowered Tyrant
Prerequisite: Dragon Specialist, Command, Intimidate 
or Poke Edu at Expert
Scene x 2 - Swift Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon use a Dragon Type Damaging 
Attack
Effect: After the Triggering Attack resolves, the 
Triggering Pokemon may use an Attack with the “Self’ 
range as a Swift Action, if able. This Attack must be 
At-Will or Eo T for its Frequency. 
Bonus: Your Dragon Type Pokemon may use Status 
Category Attacks with the “Self” range even if 
they’re Enraged. 
Draconic Sovereignty
Prerequisite: Dragon Specialist, Command, Intimidate or Poke 
Edu at Adept
At-Will - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon hits a Dragon Type Damaging Attack 
against a single Enemy that is Vulnerable, Weakened, or is 
suffering from a Status Affliction
Effect: The Triggering Attack ignores Type Effectiveness 
(Including Immunity) and is treated as Super Effective. This 
Attack cannot benefit from any other Feature if this Effect 
Applies and its Effectiveness cannot be increased beyond 1.5 x 
Dominus Prime
Prerequisite: Dragon Specialist, 3 Dragon Specialist Features, 
Command, Intimidate or Poke Edu at Master
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon use a Dragon Type Attack 
Effect: The Triggering Attack cannot miss. If the user has at 
least +2 CS in Attack, the Triggering Attack is automatically 
a Critical Hit. If the user has at least +2 CS in Special Attack, 
the Triggering Attack automatically triggers its Effect Range. 
A Pokemon may only be affected by this Feature once per 
Scene
Dragon Specialist
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Type Specialist (Dragon as your chosen Type) 
[or]
Prerequisite 2: Command, Intimidate or Poke Edu at Adept 
Static 
Effect: Your Pokemon may become Enraged as a Swift Action. 
Whenever your Pokemon are Enraged, they cannot become 
Provoked. While your Pokemon are Enraged, their Dragon Type 
Attacks have their Area of Effects increased by +1. If an Attack 
would be 1-Target, it may become Blast 2 instead of having its 
Area of Effect increased. 
Dragon Specialists excel in training Pokemon that are regal and 
ferocious in nature, often being just as formidable as their Pokemon. 
Dragon Specialists can bring out the primal power of their Dragons to 
be as ferocious as their type should be, effectiveness be damned.
DRAGON SPECIALIST

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.75)
body:
7575
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
ELECTRIC SPECIALIST
Electric Specialists excel in training Pokemon that obviously use 
electricity and lightning in some capacity. Unlike normal Trainers, 
Electric Specialists have the ability to measure the electrical voltage 
of their Pokemon and utilize it to their advantage in combat. 
Electric Specialist
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Type Specialist (Electric as your chosen Type) 
[or]
Prerequisite 2: Focus, Poke Edu or Tech Edu at Adept
Static 
Effect: Your Pokemon’s Damaging Electric Type Attacks gain a 
18+ Effect Range to cause their Targets to become Paralyzed 
if they don’t have one already. If they already have one, it is 
increased by +1. Whenever your Pokemon use a Damaging 
Attack against a Paralyzed Enemy, they cannot resist it. 
Electrical Charge
Prerequisite: Electric Specialist, Focus, Poke Edu or 
Tech Edu at Novice
Static 
Effect: Your Pokemon gain Voltage counters (Max 6) 
whenever any of the conditions below are met. If 
multiple conditions are met at the same time, they 
stack. Your Pokemon have a bonus to Paralyze Effect 
Ranges equal to half the number of Voltage Counters 
they have (Rounded Up)

• They miss an Electric Attack against all Targets - 2 
Counters

• They use an Electric Status Attack - 1 Counter

• They use a Self Attack - 1 Counter

• They gain an Affliction - 2 Counters
Electrical Overload
Prerequisite: Electrical Charge, Focus, Poke Edu or Tech 
Edu at Expert
At-Will - Special 
Effect: Your Pokemon must activate this Feature as a 
Swift Action when they declare the usage of an Electric 
Type Attack. Apply any number of the Effects below to 
the Triggering Attack, then continue with the Attack’s 
resolution (Effects can be chosen multiple times). After 
the resolution, they must expend the Voltage Counters 
equal to the cost, or half (Rounded Up) if it missed. 

• 1 Counter - Grant the Attack Smite. If it already has 
Smite, it has a +2 Bonus to Accuracy.

• 2 Counters - Increase the Area of Effect by +1 or 
change the Range to Blast 2.

• 3 Counters - Ignore Type Effectiveness and treat 
the Attack as if it were Super Effective or Neutral 
Effectiveness if they were to be Immune. 
System Shock
Prerequisite: Electric Specialist, Focus, Poke Edu or Tech Edu 
at Adept
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon cause an Enemy to become Paralyzed 
or would Paralyze an Enemy that is already Paralyzed. 
Effect: Choose one of the Effects to apply to the affected 
Enemy:

• The Target becomes Suppressed.

• The Target cannot use a Movement Action or Reaction for 
the rest of the Round.

• The Target’s Abilities are disabled while they’re Paralyzed.
Chain Lightning
Prerequisite: Electric Specialist, 3 Electric Specialist Features, 
Focus, Poke Edu or Tech Edu at Master
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon hit with a 1-Target Electric Attack
Effect: Before Damage Calculation, choose another Enemy 
within 3 m of the Target. They also become a Target of the 
Triggering Attack and perform another Accuracy Roll against 
them. This Accuracy Roll has a penalty equal to the number 
of meters they are away from the original Target. If this Attack 
hits, you may repeat this effect but based on the position of 
the 2 nd Target. The 3 rd Target cannot be the original Target.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.76)
body:
7676
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
Fairy Specialists excel in training Pokemon that have a mystical or 
even a chaotic aura. Through this Class, these Trainers can harness 
the power of Fairy Lights, created by their Pokemon in order to 
redirect their energy to help their allies or lead to magical ruin!
Fairy Specialist
[Advanced] [Class]
Prerequisite 1: Type Specialist (Fairy as yourchosen Type) [or]
Prerequisite 2: Charm, Guile or Poke Edu at Adept
At-Will - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon use a Fairy Type Attack or your Fairy 
Type Pokemon use a Status Category Attack 
Effect: A Fairy Light is summoned in an Adjacent, unoccupied 
space. If the Triggering Attack’s Accuracy Roll was a Natural 
15+ and/or if it was a Status Attack used as a Standard Action, 
one more Fairy Light is Summoned. If the Triggering Attack 
didn’t have an Accuracy Check, you may perform a Luck Roll 
instead. 
Bonus: Fairy Lights may be expended to grant the Target a Tick 
of Temporary Hit Points which may stack on existing Temp HP . 
Mystic Blessing
Prerequisite: Fairy Specialist, Charm, Guile or Poke 
Edu at Novice
At-Will - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Fairy Type Pokemon target an Ally with 
an Ability or Status Attack or Maneuver 
Effect: Choose Accuracy, Save Checks or Effect Ranges 
for the Target(s) to gain a bonus equal to your Tier 
Level until the end of their next Turn. This Feature can 
only Target a Combatant once per Round. 
Bonus: Fairy Lights may be expended to restore a 
Tick of Hit Points to the Target, or two Ticks if they’re 
below 50% HP .
Phantasmal Folklore
Prerequisite: Fairy Specialist, Charm, Guile or Poke 
Edu at Expert
Static 
Effect: Each of your Pokemon gain an Ability based on 
the type of Fairy you perceive them as or have trained 
them as. You may change this choice as an Extended 
Action when Training the Pokemon during Downtime.

• Caretaker (Blessed Touch), Cursed (Cursed Body), 
Guardian (Gentle Vibe), Malicious (Pressure), 
Mystical (Starlight), Nature Spirit (Flower Veil), 
Temptress (Cute Charm), Trickster (Prankster)
Fae Trance
Prerequisite: Fairy Specialist, Charm, Guile or Poke Edu at 
Adept
Scene x 2 - Special 
Trigger: Your Pokemon hit a Fairy Type Attack or a Social 
Attack 
Effect: Your Pokemon must use a Swift Action to activate 
this Feature. Choose a Target hit by the Triggering Attack to 
become Dazed, Entranced or Suppressed, Whenever this 
Target would end their Turn while having an Affliction gained 
this way (After Save Checks), a Fairy Light is created in a space 
that is adjacent to them. 
Bonus: Fairy Lights may be expended to grant the Target a 
bonus or penalty to their next Save Check equal to your Tier 
Level. 
Ancient Rite
Prerequisite: Fairy Specialist, 3 Fairy Specialist Features, 
Charm, Guile or Poke Edu at Master
Scene - Standard Action 
Target: Two Fairy Lights on the Field and your Active Pokemon 
with a Damaging Fairy Type Attack on their Battle Attack List 
Effect: Draw a Zone in the shape of a rectangle that connects 
both of the Targeted Fairy Lights as corners of the Zone, 
then the Fairy Lights are expended. The Targeted Pokemon 
may use a Fairy Type Damaging Attack as a Free Action with 
the Range being replaced with all Allies or Enemies (Of your 
choice) in the Zone, ignoring Frequency. Using an Attack this 
way does not create Fairy Lights.
FAIRY SPECIALIST
GM Note - As a GM, you may allow more ability options based on 
how the Trainer is training their Pokemon in the ways of a Fairy 
Ace. Malicious could grant Cruelty instead if desired but be wary 
with what you allow.
Mechanic - Fairy Light
Fairy Lights float in the space they occupy, have the Glow Capability, 
have 1 Hit Point and are Immune to Physical Damage. On your Turn, 
you may have each Fairy Light Slide up to 4 m as a Free Action. If they 
were to enter the space of an occupied Combatant, you may apply 
an Effect from the Fairy Specialist Class that a Fairy Light is able 
to do when expended, then the Fairy Light disappears. Fairy 
Lights are expended at the start and end of a Scene.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.77)
body:
7777
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
Retaliating Strike
Prerequisite: Fighting Specialist, Athletics, Combat or 
Poke Edu at Novice
Scene x 2 - Special
Trigger: Your Pokemon are hit by an Adjacent Enemy
Effect: Your Pokemon must activate this Feature 
by using a Reaction when it would Trigger. After 
the Triggering Attack resolves, the Pokemon hit by 
the Attack may perform an Attack of Opportunity 
against the Triggering Enemy as a Free Action. If the 
Triggering Pokemon had their Adversary Mark, they 
may instead use a Damaging Fighting-Type Attack 
with a Frequency of At-Will instead of a Basic Attack. 
Bonus: Whenever a Combatant with your Adversary 
Mark would Disengage out of a space that is 
Adjacent to your Pokemon, they trigger an Attack of 
Opportunity, ignoring Disengage.
Who’s Next?
Prerequisite: Fighting Specialist, Athletics, Combat or 
Poke Edu at Expert
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: An Enemy with an Adversary Mark applied by 
you Faints
Effect: Choose an Enemy to apply the Adversary Mark 
to. Your Active Pokemon gain a Tick of Temporary Hit 
Points and +1 CS in a Stat of their Choice. 
Boastful Challenger
Prerequisite: Fighting Specialist, Athletics, Combat or Poke 
Edu at Adept
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon hit a Fighting or Melee, 1 Target 
Damaging Attack
Effect: The Target becomes Provoked by the Attacker until the 
end of their next Turn. If the Target was their Adversary, the 
attacker resists their next Damaging Attack by an additional 
step. An Enemy can only be affected by Boastful Challenger 
once per Scene. 
Smashing Punishment
Prerequisite: Fighting Specialist, 3 Fighting Specialist 
Features, Athletics, Combat or Poke Edu at Master
Scene - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon hit an Adjacent Enemy with a 
Fighting-Type Damaging Attack
Effect: The Target becomes Vulnerable until the end of the 
next Round. In addition apply one of the following Effects to 
the Target:

• Before Damage Calculations, the Target’s Defense or Special 
Defense is set to -2 CS.

• The Target gains the Wounded Affliction.

• The Target loses one Coat that they are currently affected 
by and it cannot be Activated in response to this 
Feature’s Activation.
Bonus: Your Pokemon’s Attacks against their Adversary ignore 
their Physical Evasion.
Fighting Specialist
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Type Specialist (Fighting as your chosen Type) [or]
Prerequisite 2: Athletics, Combat or Poke Edu at Adept 
At-Will - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon hit with a Melee or Fighting Type 
Damaging Attack on a single Target
Effect: The Target becomes Marked with an Adversary Mark. 
Bonus: Your Pokemon’s Fighting Type Damaging Attacks have a 
bonus to Damage Rolls equal to your Tier Value and a bonus to 
their Accuracy Rolls equal to your Tier Level. These bonuses only 
apply if the only Target is an Enemy with the Adversary Mark. 
Fighting Specialists excel in training Pokemon that prioritize brawn 
over brains, often prefering to punch their way to a solution. This 
Class’s strategy is to allow your Pokemon to single out an enemy and 
gain bonuses as they fight in close range to them in a one v one duel.
FIGHTING SPECIALIST

title: Mechanic - Fire Hazard
body:
Mechanic - Fire Hazard
Any Combatant who ends their turn on or enters as space with a 
Fire Hazard becomes Burned. Ground and Rock Type Pokemon are 
immune to Fire Hazards and destroy them when shifting through 
them. Ground, Rock, and Water Type Attacks that Target these 
Spaces also destroy these Hazards. Fire Type Pokémon are Immune 
to this Hazard’s effects.
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
78
FIRE SPECIALIST
Fire Specialists excel in training Pokemon that burn with a fiery spirit 
as hot as their flames. Their specialty lies in empowering the fire of 
their Pokemon, leaving residual embers on the field and leaving burns 
that are stronger than normal. It’s time to turn up the heat!
Fire Specialist
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Type Specialist (Fire as your chosen Type) [or]
Prerequisite 2: Focus, Intuition or Poke Edu at Adept 
Static 
Effect: Your Pokemon’s Damaging Fire Type Attacks gain a 
18+ Effect Range to cause their Targets to become Burned. If 
they already have a Burn Effect Range, it is increased by +2. 
Whenever a Fire Hazard or your Pokemon Burn a Target that 
is already Burned, they lose a Tick of HIt Points and gain +1 
Combustion Counter (Max 3). Whenever a Burned Combat 
with a Combustion Counter would cure the Burned Affliction, 
they instead remove a Combustion Counter.
Fan the Flames
Prerequisite: Fire Specialist, Focus, Intuition or Poke 
Edu at Novice
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokémon uses a Fire Type Attack
Effect: Instead of its usual range, the attack may be 
performed as if it had a range of Burst 1 if Melee, or 
Close Blast 2 if ranged. If the Attack is already a Burst, 
Blast, or Line, increase the size of the Attack’s area by 
+1 (Burst 1 becomes Burst 2, etc). Regardless of if the 
Attack hits, Fire Hazards are created on each space 
within the Attack’s Range.
Blazing Battlefield
Prerequisite: Fire Specialist, Focus, Intuition or Poke 
Edu at Expert
Scene - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokémon would use a Fire Type Attack
Effect: You may ignore the Range of the Triggering 
Attack. Instead, choose any number of Fire Hazards 
within 3 m of the Triggering Pokemon and create a 
3 x 3 Zone around each chosen Fire Hazard, centered 
on the Hazard. The Attack’s Range is all spaces within 
the created Zones. Each Hazard chosen this way is 
destroyed after Attack Resolution. 
Bonus: Your Pokemon may originate any Fire Type 
Attack from a Fire Hazard within 5 m of them, but 
after Attack Resolution, the Hazard is destroyed. 
Severe Burns
Prerequisite: Fire Specialist, Focus, Intuition or Poke Edu 
at Adept
Static 
Effect: Enemies that are Burned by your Pokemon or Fire 
Hazards you create cannot restore Hit Points while Burned. 
In addition, whenever they would lose Hit Points from 
the Burned Affliction, they lose an Additional Tick per 
Combustion Counter they have. 
Spontaneous Combustion
Prerequisite: Fire Specialist, 3 Fire Specialist Features, Focus, 
Intuition or Poke Edu at Master
Scene x 2 – Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon use a Fire Type Attack against a 
Burned Enemy 
Effect: All Burned Targets of the Triggering Attack become 
cured of the Burned Affliction and all Combustion Counters 
they had. The Triggering Attack cannot miss Targets cured this 
way. If the Triggering Attack was Damaging and they cured 
Combustion Counters, the Attack also becomes a Critical HIt 
automatically and they cannot use Reactions against it.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.79)
body:
7979
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
FLYING SPECIALIST
Flying Specialists excel in training Pokemon that are as free as the 
wind itself. These Trainers specialize in swift Pokemon that can use 
the sky to their advantage, can manipulate the battlefield with their 
gales, and can act swiftly with speed only an avian can perform. 
Flying Specialist
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Type Specialist (Flying as your chosen Type) [or]
Prerequisite 2: Acrobatics, Perception or Poke Edu at Adept
Static 
Effect: Your Pokemon gain the Quick Capability. Your Flying Type 
Pokemon may use the Disengage Maneuver as a Swift Action as 
well as a Movement Action and when they do, they may move 
3 m instead of 1. 
Skyward Bound
Prerequisite: Flying Specialist, Acrobatics, Perception or 
Poke Edu at Novice
At-Will - Special 
Effect: Your Pokemon with the Flier Capability may 
activate this Feature as a Movement Action to fly up to 
25 m in the air and leave the field, becoming Untargetable 
for this duration. At the beginning of their next Turn they 
re-enter the Field as a Movement Action and descend 
down to any space within 10 m of their previous location, 
then their next Damaging Attack this Turn gains the Smite 
Keyword. Each Pokemon may only activate Skyward 
Bound once per Scene. 
Note: This Feature cannot be used if the user is in an 
area with a height of less than 10 m. This Feature allows 
the user to ignore the Flier Capability, allowing them to 
exceed 4 m in the air.
Aerial Control
Prerequisite: Flying Specialist, Acrobatics, Perception or 
Poke Edu at Expert
At-Will - Special 
Effect: Your Flying Type Pokemon may activate this 
Feature as a Swift Action to perform any of the following:

• Choose an Enemy within 5 m to Slide 3 m in any 
direction unless they pass a Tough CR (3) Acrobatics 
Check

• The Weather becomes Windy or the Weather is 
removed, of your choice. The Weather may only become 
Windy this way once per Scene

• In a Close Blast 3 or Line 6 Range, all Hazardous Terrain 
that was created by an Attack or Ability is destroyed and 
reverted to Basic Terrain. 
Gale Strike
Prerequisite: Flying Specialist, Acrobatics, Perception or Poke 
Edu at Adept
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon miss a Flying Type Attack against all 
Targets
Effect: The Accuracy Roll is performed once again. If the 
Attack would result in a Critical Hit, it is instead a normal hit, 
but Gale Strike’s Frequency is not expended. 
Tornado Surge
Prerequisite: Flying Specialist, 3 Flying Specialist Features, 
Acrobatics, Perception or Poke Edu at Master
Scene - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon would take their Turn 
Effect: Choose two different options from the following list to 
grant the Triggering Pokemon for this Turn.

• An Extra Standard Action: This can only be used to use a 
Flying Type Attack that is At-Will, use a Flying Type Attack that 
is EOT, or use a Naturally Flying Type Status Attack.

• An Extra Swift Action: This can only be used for Abilities, 
Maneuvers or Flying Specialist Features.

• An Extra Movement Action: This must be used to Move 
spaces.

• An Extra Save Check: Taking this allows you to roll your 
Save Check twice, taking the higher result.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.80)
body:
8080
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
Ghost Specialists excel in training Pokemon that live on the edge of life 
and death and have a spectral nature. Being attuned to Ghost Types 
allows these Trainers to hex their enemies with curses and debuffs 
utilizing Curse Tokens which are gained from ghastly events in combat.
Phase Shift
Prerequisite: Ghost Specialist, Intimidate, Occult Edu 
or Poke Edu at Novice
At-Will - Special 
Effect: Your Ghost Type Pokemon may activate this 
Feature as a Movement Action to remove themselves 
from the Field and become Untargetable for this 
duration. At the beginning of their next Turn they may 
reappear in any space they could have moved to from 
their previous location, then their next Attack ignores 
Speed Evasion. Each Pokemon may only activate 
Phase Shift once per Scene. 
Bonus: Your Pokemon with the Phaser Capability may 
instead use it as a Free Action.
Cursed Malediction
Prerequisite: Ghost Specialist, Intimidate, Occult Edu 
or Poke Edu at Expert
Scene x 2 - Free Action
Trigger: Your Pokemon is hit by an Attack
Effect: After Damage Calculations, you may spend any 
of your Curse Tokens and apply its conditions to the 
Triggering Enemy. If the Triggering Enemy has a Status 
Affliction, they have a -4 Penalty to their next Save 
Check. 
Bonus: Whenever an Enemy fails a Save Check, you 
gain a Curse Token. You can only gain up to two per 
Round this way. 
Vampirism
Prerequisite: Ghost Specialist, Intimidate, Occult Edu or Poke 
Edu at Adept
Scene x 2 – Free Action
Trigger: Your Pokémon hits an adjacent enemy with a Ghost 
Type Attack 
Effect: Choose a Stat. After Damage Calculations (If any), 
the triggering enemy loses a Tick of Hit Points and a Combat 
Stage in that Stat. Your Pokémon gains 1 Combat Stage in 
the chosen Stat, and a Tick of Temporary Hit Points. If the 
Triggering Attack was a Critical Hit or the Weather is Foggy, 
this Feature’s Frequency isn’t expended.
Spectral Surprise
Prerequisite: Ghost Specialist, 3 Ghost Specialist Features, 
Intimidate, Occult Edu or Poke Edu at Master
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon use a Ghost Type Attack
Effect: The Triggering Attack gains the Smite Keyword. After 
the Triggering Attack is resolved, they may spend any of their 
Curse Tokens and apply its conditions to any targets of the 
Triggering Attack as a Free Action. 
Ghost Specialist
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Type Specialist (Ghost as your chosen Type) [or]
Prerequisite 2: Intimidate, Occult Edu or Poke Edu at Adept 
Static 
Effect: Whenever your Pokemon use a Ghost Type Attack, 
you gain 1 Curse Token (Max 6) after Attack resolution. Your 
Pokemon may use a Standard Action, or a Free Action upon 
Fainting, to expend any amount of Curse Tokens to apply 
conditions to an Enemy within 5 m of them listed below at their 
listed cost:

• 1 Curse Token: The Target becomes Suppressed

• 2 Curse Tokens: The Target becomes Cursed or loses -3 CS in a 
Stat of your Choice

• 3 Curse Tokens: The Target has one Stat of your choice lowered 
to -2 CS

• 4 Curse Tokens: The Target becomes Drowsy and cannot be 
cured through sources other than a Save Check.
GHOST SPECIALIST

title: Example - Cross Polination
body:
Example - Cross Polination
Your Pokemon use Leaf Storm and hit with it. They replace 
following effect with the effect of Grass Whistle, which is also on 
their Battle Attack List. 
Before (Leaf Storm)
After Damage Calculations, lower the Offensive Stat used for this 
Attack by -2 CS. Smite
After (Leaf Storm w/Grass Whistle Effect)
The Target becomes Drowsy or Entranced. On a Miss, they instead 
become Vulnerable until the end of the next Round. Spirit Surge.
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
81
GRASS SPECIALIST
Grass Specialists excel in training Pokemon that abide in nature. These 
Trainers often specialize in the wide array of status attacks a Grass 
Pokemon can learn and the growth potential of grass Pokemon. This 
allows them to make their Grass Types stronger and be versatile.
Grass Specialist
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Type Specialist (Grass as your chosen Type) [or]
Prerequisite 2: Gen Edu, Nature Edu or Poke Edu at Adept
At-Will - Extended Action 
Trigger: You use a Downtime Action to Train your Pokemon
Target: Your Trained Pokemon and a Grass Type Status Attack 
on their Battle or Known Attack List
Effect: The Targeted Attack no longer takes an Attack Slot and 
is always on their Battle Attack List. A Pokemon can only have 
one Attack affected by this Feature at a time; if a new Attack is 
chosen for the Targeted Pokemon, the previous one loses 
this Effect.
Photosynthesize 
Prerequisite: Grass Specialist, Gen Edu, Nature Edu or Poke 
Edu at Adept
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Grass Type Pokemon end their Turn without 
using a Damaging Attack or in Sunny Weather
Effect: Choose an Effect to apply:

• The user restores two Ticks of Hit Points.

• The user gains a Tick of Temporary Hit Points.

• The user is cured of a Status Affliction.
Cross Pollination
Prerequisite: Grass Specialist, 3 Grass Specialist Features, Gen 
Edu, Nature Edu or Poke Edu at Master
Scene - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon hit a Damaging Grass Type Attack as a 
Standard Action
Effect: The Effect of the Triggering Attack is replaced with the 
Effect of a Naturally Grass Type Status Attack on the User’s 
Battle Attack List. 
Floral Embodiment
Prerequisite: Grass Specialist, Gen Edu, Nature Edu or 
Poke Edu at Novice
At-Will - Extended Action
Trigger: You use the Training Downtime Action on 
your Grass Type Pokemon
Effect: They gain either the Flower Power or Flower 
Veil Ability. A Pokemon can only have one Ability 
gained this way at a time.
Enduring Bloom
Prerequisite: Grass Specialist, Gen Edu, Nature Edu or 
Poke Edu at Expert
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Grass Type Pokemon is dealt Super 
Effective Damage
Effect: The Grass Type Pokemon gains a Tick of 
Temporary Hit Points and gains +1 CS in a Stat of your 
choice. If the Weather is Sunny, they also resist the 
triggering Attack by an additional damage step. A 
Pokemon may only be affected by this Feature once 
per Scene.

title: Mechanic - Spike Hazard
body:
Mechanic - Spike Hazard
Spaces with Spike Hazards are treated as Slow Terrain. Any 
Grounded Enemy that enters a space with a Spike Hazard loses one 
Tick of Hit Points and cannot gain Hit Points or Temporary Hit Points 
until the end of the next Round.
8282
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
GROUND SPECIALIST
Ground Specialists excel in training Pokemon that are masters of the 
ground beneath us, being able to manipulate the very soil that we walk 
on. These Trainers specialize in manipulating the field, creating spikes, 
creating large attacks and even tripping others as you control the land.
Ground Specialist
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Type Specialist (Ground as your chosen Type) [or]
Prerequisite 2: Intuition, Perception or Poke Edu at Adept
At-Will - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon use a Ground Type Attack 
Effect: After the Attack’s resolution, create a 3 x 3 Zone that 
includes one Target of the Triggering Attack. Spike Hazards are 
created in Spaces in this Zone. If the Triggering Pokemon has 
the Groundshaper Capability, they may use it on any number of 
spaces in this zone as a Free Action. 
Embedded Thorns
Prerequisite: Ground Specialist, Intuition, Perception 
or Poke Edu at Novice
Static 
Effect: When Enemies Trigger Spike Hazards that 
are created by you or your Pokemon they gain 
an Embedded Coat. Whenever an Enemy with an 
Embedded Coat uses a Movement Action for anything 
other than removing the Embedded Coat, they 
lose a Tick of Hit Points and cannot gain Hit Points 
or Temporary Hit points until the end of the next 
Round. The Embedded Coat may be expended as a 
Movement Action
Seismic Warning
Prerequisite: Ground Specialist, Intuition, Perception 
or Poke Edu at Expert
At-Will - Special
Effect: Your Pokemon may use a Swift Action to create 
a 3 x 3 Zone on the Field within 5 m of them, then 
choose a Naturally Ground Type non-Field Attack 
on their Battle Attack List. At the end of the next 
Round, the Attack is used as a Free Action (Following 
Frequency) with its Range being all spaces within that 
Zone. If the Attack is Damaging, it is resisted by an 
additional Damage Step. 
Upheaval
Prerequisite: Ground Specialist, Intuition, Perception or Poke 
Eduat Adept
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon use a Ground Type Attack or an Attack 
with the Groundsource Keyword 
Effect: After the Accuracy Roll and before determining if it 
hit or not, one Target of the Triggering Attack must make an 
Acrobatics Check with a Standard CR (2) or else they become 
Tripped. If the Triggering Attacks’ Natural Accuracy Roll was 
a 15+, the Skill Check becomes a Tough CR (3) instead. If the 
Triggering Pokemon is Tier 3, increase the Challenge Rating by 
+1. 
Unraveled Earth
Prerequisite: Ground Specialist, 3 Ground Specialist Features, 
Intuition, Perception or Poke Edu at Master
Scene x 2 - Free Action
Trigger: Your Pokemon would use a Ground Type Attack or an 
Attack with the Groundsource Keyword
Effect: The Triggering Attack must be used as a Full Action 
instead of its former Action cost in order to Trigger this 
Feature. The Range of the Triggering Attack is changed to 
Burst 3 and gains the Friendly and Smite Keyword. If any 
Target would be Immune to Ground Type or Groundsource 
Attacks, it is instead treated as Neutral Effectiveness. A 
Pokemon can only Trigger this Feature once per Scene.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.83)
body:
8383
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
ICE SPECIALIST
Ice Specialists excel in training Pokemon whose cold tactics weaken 
those around them. The job of an ice specialist is to make their Ice 
Pokemon sturdier and to empower their Pokemon’s Ice Attacks to 
cause worse effects on their enemies, including a deep chill. 
Ice Specialist
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Type Specialist (Ice as your chosen Type) [or]
Prerequisite 2: Athletics, Nature Edu or Poke Edu at Adept
Static
Effect: Your Pokemon’s Ice Type Attacks inflict the Chilled 
Affliction on an 18+ or increase existing Chilled Effect Ranges 
by +2. Whenever your Pokemon would cause a Chilled 
Pokemon to become Chilled again, they gain a Permafrost 
Coat. Whenever an Enemy with a Permafrost Coat is hit by a 
Damaging Attack, it automatically becomes a Critical hit, then 
the Coat is expended. 
Frozen Solid
Prerequisite: Ice Specialist, Athletics, Nature Edu or Poke Edu 
at Adept
Scene x 2 - Free Action
Trigger: Your Pokemon would apply a Permafrost Coat
Effect: Instead of having the Coat apply to them, they lose 
their next Standard Action and become Slowed. An enemy 
can only be affected this way once per Scene.
Bonus: Your Pokemon also apply a Permafrost coat when 
they cause an Enemy to become Chilled if they are Vulnerable 
or Weakened. 
Deep Cold
Prerequisite: Ice Specialist, 3 Ice Specialist Features, Athletics, 
Nature Edu or Poke Edu at Master
Scene - Swift Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon hit with an Ice Type Damaging Attack
Effect: One Target of the Triggering Attack becomes Chilled, 
then choose a Stat of theirs to be set to -2 CS. 
Glacial Body
Prerequisite: Ice Specialist, Athletics, Nature Edu or 
Poke Edu at Novice
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Ice Type Pokemon are hit by a Damaging 
Attack
Effect: The Ice Type Pokemon gains Damage 
Reduction against the Triggering Attack equal to their 
Tick Value. If the Weather is Snowy and the Triggering 
Attack is Super Effective, it is resisted by an additional 
damage step as well. 
Arctic Zeal
Prerequisite: Ice Specialist, Athletics, Nature Edu or 
Poke Edu at Expert
Scene x 2 - Swift Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon use with an Ice Type Attack as 
a Standard Action
Effect: Choose one of the Effects to apply:

• All Targets of the Triggering Attack lose -2 CS in a 
Stat of your Choice (Choose for each)

• You may use an Ice Type Blessing Attack with its 
Versatile Effect as a Free Action, ignoring Frequency

• If the Weather is Snowy, gain +1 CS in a Stat of your 
choice

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.84)
body:
8484
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
NORMAL SPECIALIST
Normal Specialists excel in training Pokemon that are, well, normal. 
Average. Run of the mill. There’s nothing special about normal ace 
except its ability to make normal Pokemon less normal and excel in raw 
strength or prowess. Or they could bring others down to their level.
Normal Specialist
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Type Specialist (Normal as your chosen Type) [or]
Prerequisite 2: Charm, Intuition or Poke Edu at Adept
Static 
Effect: Your Pokemon’s Normal Type Attacks have a Damage 
Bonus equal to your Tier Value. Whenever your Pokemon use 
a Normal Type Attack as a Standard Action, they gain Damage 
Reduction equal to your Tier Value until the end of the next 
Round. Damage Reduction gained this way cannot stack with 
itself. 
Plainly Precise
Prerequisite: Normal Specialist, Charm, Intuition or 
Poke Edu at Novice
Static 
Effect: Your Pokemon’s Normal Type Damaging 
Attacks have their Accuracy Roll performed twice, 
taking the higher result
Simple Minded
Prerequisite: Normal Specialist, Charm, Intuition or 
Poke Edu at Expert
Static 
Effect: Your Normal Type Pokemon gain the Simple 
Ability.
Extra Ordinary
Prerequisite: Normal Specialist, Charm, Intuition or Poke Edu 
at Adept
At-Will - Special 
Trigger: Your Pokemon resolve a Normal Type Attack
Effect: The Triggering Pokemon must use a Swift Action to 
activate this Feature. The Triggering Pokemon either gains 
+1 CS in a Stat of their choice or a +2 Modifier to any of the 
following Combat Values for the rest of the Scene. 

• Accuracy, Effect Range, Critical Hit, Evasion, Save Checks
Contagious Normality
Prerequisite: Normal Specialist, 3 Normal Specialist Features, 
Charm, Intuition or Poke Edu at Master
Scene x 2 - Free Action
Trigger: Your Pokemon hit an Enemy with a Normal 
Type Attack used as a Standard Action
Effect: Choose one of the Effects to apply to the Targets hit 
by the Triggering Attack. An Enemy can only be affected by 
Contagious Normality once per Scene:

• The Target’s next Damaging Attack cannot exceed Neutral 
Effectiveness

• The Target’s Abilities are disabled until the end of the 
next Round.

• The Target’s Combat Stages are set to +0 until the end 
of the next Round. After this duration, they revert to their 
original value, overwriting any changes that may have 
occurred since this was inflicted.

title: Mechanic - Gas Hazard
body:
Mechanic - Gas Hazard
Any Enemy who ends their Turn on or enters a space with a Gas 
Hazard loses one Tick of Hit Points and suffers any additional effects 
derived from the source. This Effect is ignored by Combatants with 
the Breathless Capability.
8585
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
POISON SPECIALIST
Poison Specialists excel in training Pokemon that weaken and subdue 
their enemies with their venom. These Trainers specialize in having 
more effective poison that has a stronger potency on their enemies 
and can even weaken their physical health and combat stats. 
Poison Specialist
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Type Specialist (Poison as your chosen Type) [or]
Prerequisite 2: Intimidate, Poke Edu or Stealth at Adept 
Static 
Effect: Your Pokemon’s Damaging Poison Type Attacks gain a 
18+ Effect Range to cause their Targets to become Poisoned. 
If they already have a Poisoned Effect Range, it is increased 
by +2. Whenever a Hazard or your Pokemon Poison a Target 
that is already Poisoned, they gain +1 Venom Counter (Max 3). 
Whenever a Poisoned Combatant with a Venom Counter would 
cure the Poisoned Affliction, they instead remove a Venom 
Counter. 
Miasma
Prerequisite: Poison Specialist, Intimidate, Poke Edu 
or Stealth at Novice
Scene x 2 – Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokémon uses a Poison Type Attack 
Effect: Gas Hazards are created in the spaces within 
the Range of this Attack. If the Triggering Attack had 
a single Target, it may instead create Gas Hazards 
in a Ranged Blast 3 centered around that target. If 
the Triggering Attack missed, this Feature does not 
require a usage of its Frequency to be activated. 
Enemies that Trigger this Hazard become Poisoned.
Debilitate
Prerequisite: Poison Specialist, Intimidate, Poke Edu 
or Stealth at Expert
Scene - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon would Poison an Enemy, Grant 
them a Venom Counter or land a Critical Hit with a 
Poison Type Attack. 
Effect: They instead become Weakened or Vulnerable 
(Of your choice) until the end of the next Round. If 
the Trigger was a Critical Hit, the Triggering Attack 
is no longer a Critical Hit but inflicts one of the prior 
listed Conditions.
Potent Venom
Prerequisite: Poison Specialist, Intimidate, Poke Edu or 
Stealth at Adept
At-Will - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon Poison an Enemy or grant them a 
Venom Counter
Effect: If they became Poisoned, you may have any Stat 
become lowered by the effects of the Affliction, not just 
Special Defense. Additionally, the chosen Stat can’t be raised 
while they’re Poisoned. If they gained a Venom Counter, they 
lose -2 CS in a Stat of your Choice. 
Bonus: Whenever Poisoned Enemies would lose Hit Points 
from the Poisoned Affliction, they lose an Additional Tick per 
Venom Counter they have.
Corrosive Blight
Prerequisite: Poison Specialist, 3 Poison Specialist Features, 
Intimidate, Poke Edu or Stealth at Master
Scene x 3 - Free Action
Trigger: Your Pokémon hits a Poisoned Enemy with a Poison 
Type Attack 
Effect: The Target loses a Tick of Hit Points, then loses 
another for every Stat they have negative CS in. A Target may 
only be affected by Corrosive Blight once per Scene.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.86)
body:
GM Note - As a GM you may curate which Attacks they’re allowed to 
choose through this Feature for sake of balance or table fun. Attacks like 
Teleport can be deemed to be unlearnable if you don’t want players to 
access it. Additionally be wary of type shifted Attacks. 
8686
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
PSYCHIC SPECIALIST
Psychic Specialists excel in training Pokemon that are trained in the 
mystic arts and sometimes have intelligence equal to our own. Unlike 
other specialists, the Trainers psionically link with their Pokemon, 
allowing them access to the psychic capabilities their partners possess.
Psychic Specialist
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Type Specialist (Psychic as your chosen Type) [or]
Prerequisite 2: Focus, Occult Edu or Poke Edu at Adept 
Bind 2 - Extended Action 
Target: A Pokemon you own and a Psychic Status Attack 
currently on their Battle Attack List 
Effect: While this Feature is bound, you have the chosen Attack 
added to your Attack List. 
Psychic Sponge
Prerequisite: Psychic Specialist, Focus, Occult Edu or 
Poke Edu at Novice
Static 
Effect: All of your Pokemon gain +1 Attack Slot on 
their Battle Attack List, however it can only be used
for a Psychic Type Status Attack. Whenever your 
Psychic Type Pokemon see a Psychic Type Attack used 
by another Combatant, they may add it to their Battle 
Attack List for the rest of the Scene. Attacks added 
this way do not take an Attack Slot. 
Mindbreak
Prerequisite: Psychic Specialist, Focus, Occult Edu or 
Poke Edu at Expert
At-Will - Free Action
Trigger: Your Pokemon use a Psychic Damaging Attack
Effect: Choose one of the following to apply. You may 
choose an additional effect for each Mental Affliction 
the Target is affected by:

• The Triggering Attack gains a bonus to Damage Rolls 
equal to your Tier Value

• The Triggering Attack gains a bonus to Effect Ranges 
equal to your Tier Level

• The Triggering Attack ignores Evasion from Special 
Defense.
Psychic Resonance
Prerequisite: Psychic Specialist, Focus, Occult Edu or Poke 
Edu at Adept
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon hit with a Psychic Type 
Damaging Attack
Effect: After the Attack’s resolution, roll 1 d 4. All Targets hit 
with the Triggering Attack become inflicted with the following 
Status Affliction. On a 1, they become Suppressed. On a 2, 
they become Dazed. On a 3, they become Enraged. On a 4, 
they become Drowsy.
Psionic Manipulation
Prerequisite: Psychic Specialist, 3 Psychic Specialist Features, 
Focus, Occult Edu or Poke Edu at Master
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon use a Psychic Typed Attack as a 
Standard Action
Effect: Your Pokémon may immediately use a different 
Psychic-Type Status Attack from its Attack List with a range 
of Blessing, Field, Hazard, or Self as a Swift Action. If the 
Triggering Attack was not a Status Attack, they cannot Trigger 
this Feature for the rest of the Scene.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.87)
body:
8787
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
ROCK SPECIALIST
Rock Specialists excel in training Pokemon that are born of the earth, 
soil and mountains. They specialize in flooding the field with rocky 
hazards that they can then use to either bolster their attacks, defend 
themselves or just have them impair the movement of their enemies.
Rock Specialist
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Type Specialist (Rock as your chosen Type) [or]
Prerequisite 2: Combat, Nature Edu or Poke Edu at Adept
At-Will - Extended Action 
Trigger: You use a Downtime Action to Train your Pokemon 
Target: Your Trained Pokemon 
Effect: The Target learns the Stealth Rock Attack, even if they 
normally can’t learn it. If the Target is Rock Type, the Attack 
doesn’t take an Attack Slot on their Battle Attack List. Your 
Pokemon may treat the Stealth Rock attack as if it were EOT 
Frequency instead of Scene x 2.
Igneous Impact
Prerequisite: Rock Specialist, Combat, Nature Edu or 
Poke Edu at Novice
Scene x 2 - Free Action
Trigger: Your Pokemon hit a Rock Type 
Damaging Attack 
Effect: After the Attack’s resolution, choose an Effect 
below to apply to one Target of the Triggering Attack: 

• The Target becomes Vulnerable against the next 
Attack to Target them

• The Target is Slid up to 3 m away from the user

• The Target loses -2 CS in Defense.
Sedimentary Shield
Prerequisite: Rock Specialist, Combat, Nature Edu or 
Poke Edu at Expert
Scene - Free Action
Trigger: Your Rock Type Pokemon are hit by a Super 
Effective Damaging Attack 
Effect: They resist the Triggering Attack by an 
additional Damage Step. After Damage Resolution, 
you may destroy 5 Stealth Rock Hazards within 3 m 
of the Target to have the Frequency of this Feature 
refreshed. 
Basalt Blockade
Prerequisite: Rock Specialist, Combat, Nature Edu or Poke 
Edu at Adept
Scene x 2 - Free Action
Trigger: Your Pokemon use a Rock Type Attack with a Burst or 
Blast Range
Effect: After the Triggering Attack resolves, choose up to 
6 Spaces within the Triggering Attack’s Range that are 
unoccupied to have Stealth Rock Hazards or Blocking Terrain 
created in them. Blocking Terrain created this way is treated 
as Small. 
Seismic Storm
Prerequisite: Rock Specialist, 3 Rock Specialist Features, 
Combat, Nature Edu or Poke Edu at Master
Scene - Special 
Trigger: Your Pokemon use a Rock Type Damaging Attack
Effect: Your Pokemon must activate this Feature as a Swift 
Action when Triggered. Apply one Effect below to the 
Triggering Attack. You may destroy 3 Stealth Rocks within 3 m 
of the Target to repeat the Effect of this Feature any number 
of times. 

• The Attack’s Area of Effect is increased by +1 or becomes a 
Blast 2 

• The Attack gains the Smite Keyword or if it already had it, 
gains the Sureshot Keyword

• This Feature’s Frequency is refreshed.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.88)
body:
8888
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
STEEL SPECIALIST
Steel Specialists excel in training Pokemon that are the peak of 
technological marvels. These Pokemon tend to have great defensive 
capabilities and even if they are more offensive like Bisharp, being a 
specialist of this type enhances their abilities to sustain themselves.
Steel Specialist
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Type Specialist (Steel as your chosen Type) [or]
Prerequisite 2: Focus, Poke Edu or Tech Edu at Adept 
Static 
Effect: Non-Adjacent Attacks have a penalty to their Critical Hit 
Range, Effect Range and Accuracy Rolls against your Steel Type 
Pokemon equal to your Tier Level. Your Pokemon have a bonus 
to Effect Ranges for their Steel Type Attacks equal to your Tier 
Level. 
Assault Armor
Prerequisite: Steel Specialist, Focus, Poke Edu or Tech 
Edu at Novice
Scene x 3 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon hit a Steel Type Damaging 
Attack or Your Steel Type Pokemon hits a Physical 
Damaging Attack
Effect: The Triggering Pokemon may use their Defense 
as an Offensive Stat in place of its normal Offensive 
Stat. 
Ironclad Resolve
Prerequisite: Steel Specialist, Focus, Poke Edu or Tech 
Edu at Expert
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon uses a Steel Type Attack
Effect: Choose an Effect below to apply to them until 
the start of their next Turn. If the Triggering Pokemon 
is a Steel Type, you may either ignore the Frequency 
of this Feature or apply all Effects below. Ironclad 
Resolve may only activate once per Round. 

• The User gains +3 to Save Checks

• The User gains a Tick of Temporary Hit Points

• The User has +3 Uncapped Evasion against non-
Adjacent Attacks
Ironclad Bond
Prerequisite: Steel Specialist, Focus, Poke Edu or Tech Edu at 
Adept
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: An Ally or Yourself that is adjacent to your Steel Type 
Pokemon would take Damage from a Physical Attack
Effect: When applying Damage Calculations, they may use the 
Defense Stat Value of the Steel Pokemon. 
Bonus: You and your Allies that are adjacent to your Steel 
Type Pokemon may have their Physical Evasion treated as the 
Physical Evasion of that Pokemon. 
True Steel Body
Prerequisite: Steel Specialist, 3 Steel Specialist Features, 
Focus, Poke Edu or Tech Edu at Master
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon is hit by a Damaging Attack
Effect: Your Pokemon gains Damage Reduction against the 
Attack equal to triple your highest Type Linked Skill Rank. 
Additionally, you may calculate Type Effectiveness against this 
Attack as if your Pokemon was only Steel Typed. A Pokemon 
may only be affected by True Steel Body once per Scene.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.89)
body:
8989
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
Controlled Current
Prerequisite: Water Specialist; Athletics, Intuition or Poke Edu 
at Adept
Scene x 2 - Special 
Effect: Your Pokemon may activate this Feature as a Swift 
Action to apply the following Effect to their next non-Self or 
Field Water Attack, based on their chosen tactic. 

• Cascade - Any Targeted Allies are cured of a Physical 
Affliction or have a Coat removed. If it was Damaging, they 
take no Damage. 

• Rapid - The Attack gains the Pass Keyword. Instead of going 
in a straight line, you can change direction once during the 
movement.

• Torrential - The Attack has the Friendly and Smite Keyword.
Maelstrom Strike
Prerequisite: Water Specialist; Athletics, Intuition or Poke Edu 
at Master 
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: Your Pokemon use a non-Self or Field Water Type 
Attack 
Effect: The Attack is altered based on their chosen tactic. Each 
of your Pokemon can only Trigger this once per Scene.

• Cascade - Any Allies within the Range of this Attack take no 
Damage from it and restore 5 Ticks of Hit Points

• Rapid - This also Targets all Enemies that are Adjacent to 
the original Target(s) of this Attack

• Torrential - The Attack has the Sureshot Keyword and 
cannot Trigger Reactions.
Hydro Deluge
Prerequisite: Water Specialist; Athletics, Intuition or 
Poke Edu at Novice 
At-Will - Special 
Effect: Your Pokemon may activate this Feature as a 
Swift Action to use their next non-Self or Field Water 
Type Attack as if its Range were Line 6, Burst 1, or 
Close Blast 2. Alternatively, if it already has an Area of 
Effect, increase it by +1. If the Weather is Rainy, this 
may be used once per Round as a Free Action as well. 
Tidal Tactics
Prerequisite: Water Specialist; Athletics, Intuition or 
Poke Edu at Expert 
Static 
Effect: The Effect of this Feature varies based on the 
Pokemon’s chosen tactic. 

• Cascade - Your Water Type Damaging Attacks ignore 
the restriction on the Versatile Keyword and Help 
Maneuver, allowing them to still be used. 

• Rapid - Whenever you activate the Dash Keyword, 
Targets cannot apply Speed Evasion against your 
Water Attacks

• Torrential - Whenever you use a Water Attack 
against a single Enemy, you gain the Damage Bonus 
from Water Specialist regardless if you’re under 50% 
HP . If the Weather is Rainy, this applies to all Water 
Damaging Attacks you use. 
WATER SPECIALIST
Water Specialists excel in training Pokemon that live in bodies of 
water all around the world. Their training allows their water Pokemon 
to increase the strength of their water, allowing for bigger waves and 
possibly even persistent water typhoons that circle their enemies. 
Water Specialist 
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Type Specialist (Water as your chosen Type) [or]
Prerequisite 2: Athletics, Intuition or Poke Edu at Adept
Static 
Effect: For each of your Pokemon, choose one of the tactics 
listed below. The style’s effects apply to all of their Water Type 
Attacks. Your Water Specialist Features have different effects 
based on the Pokemon’s chosen tactic.

• Cascade - Whenever you Target yourself or an Ally with a 
Water Attack, you both gain a Tick of Temporary Hit Points

• Rapid - All of your Damaging Water Attacks may be used as if 
their range were Melee, 1 Target, Dash.

• Torrential - While your Pokemon are under 50% Hit Points, 
their Water Attacks have a Damage Bonus equal to your Tier 
Value.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.90)
body:
9090
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
GENERAL RESEARCHER
Some Trainers don’t really have a research specialty and prefer 
to study a general topic or study a wide array of topics. General 
Researchers excel at being a jack of all trades and being able to be 
decent and good at multiple topics or subjects. 
General Researcher 
[Base] [Class]
Prerequisite: Novice Gen Edu
Static 
Effect: You may Rank up two different Skills you’re able to 
upgrade. Whenever you make a Skill Check for an Education 
Skill other than General Edu, you may add 1 d 6 to the roll. 
When you reach Expert Gen Edu, instead add 2 d 6. You cannot 
exceed 6 d 6 this way.
Dilettante
[Ranked 2]
Rank 1 Prerequisite: General Researcher, 
Novice Gen Edu
Rank 2 Prerequisite: General Researcher, 
Expert Gen Edu
Static 
Effect: Each Rank of Dilettante, you may perform two 
different options below. You do not need to meet 
the Skill prerequisites of chosen Talents or General 
Features. You must meet any other Prerequisites 
and have a General Education Skill Rank equal to 
the highest listed Skill Prerequisite of the chosen 
Feature or Talent. Whenever you gain a Feature or 
Talent this way, change any Skill Ranks or Skill Checks 
used directly by the Talent or Feature into General 
Education Skill Checks or Rank applications instead.

• You gain a General Feature 

• You gain a Talent

• You upgrade two different Skills by a Rank
Example: If a Feature says it requires Adept Athletics, 
it becomes Adept General Edu.
 
General Studies
[Ranked 2]
Rank 1 Prerequisite: General Researcher, Adept Gen Edu
Rank 2 Prerequisite: General Researcher, Master Gen Edu
Static 
Rank 1 Effect: Choose a Skill that is at least Novice Rank to be 
your Trained Skill. Then choose a Feature in a Class without 
the [Class] Tag that has at most Adept Rank Prerequisites 
for its Skills and lists your Trained Skill. You gain that Feature 
despite not meeting its prerequisites. 
Rank 2 Effect: Choose a Feature in a Class without the [Class] 
Tag that has at most Expert Rank Prerequisites for its Skills 
and lists your Trained Skill. You gain that Feature despite not 
meeting its prerequisite.
Example: If you choose your Trained Skill to be Combat, you 
can take Features from the Gladiator Class despite not having 
the Gladiator Feature listed in its prerequisites.
Example
Myra Witherbloom is an aspiring florist but doesn’t know too much 
about nature despite studying about it a lot. She takes Nature Edu 
as her Trained Skill. 
For the first Rank of General Studies, she takes the Floral Diversity 
Feature from the Herbalist Class, allowing her to have access to 
more Seed Bag Attacks. 
For her second Rank of General Studies, she take the Survival 
Instincts Feature from the Nature Researcher Class, since she 
knows a lot about survivng in the wilderness.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.91)
body:
Note - Chronicler Skills are Gen Edu, Intuition or Perception. 
Some common aspects to ask about during Combat for Analyze 
Maneuvers are the Combatant’s battle stance, their body language, 
their disposition, or what attack they look like they’re preparing.
9191
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
CHRONICLER
Characters with talented insight, good memory and the ability to take 
notes will likely be most comfortable as a Chronicler. These Characters 
absorb the world around them and analyze observations in order to 
gain an edge over the competition and any challenge they face.
Chronicler 
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: General Researcher [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Chronicler Skill
Static 
Effect: Whenever you use the Analyze Maneuver on a Pokemon 
or Trainer and pass its associated Skill Check (If any), they become 
Studied.If you would need to make a Skill Check for an Analyze 
Maneuver that isn’t a Chronicler Skill, you may add 2 d 6 to the roll, but 
it cannot exceed 6 d 6 this way.
Character Profile
Prerequisite: Chronicler, two Chronicler Skills at 
Novice Rank
Scene - Free Action 
Trigger: You or your Pokemon use a Maneuver with 
an Accuracy Check
Effect: The Maneuver automatically hits but still must 
make an opposed check if applicable.
Bonus: You have a Boon to all Skill Checks involving 
Studied Creatures. If they were permanently Studied, 
you also treat the Skill as one Rank higher than it is. 
Analyzed Reflexes
Prerequisite: Chronicler, 2 Chronicler Features, an 
Expert Chronicler Skill
At-Will - Special
Trigger: You or your Pokemon use an Attack
Effect: The Triggering Combatant must spend a 
Reaction to use this Feature. Targets of the Triggering 
Attack cannot use Reactions in response to the 
Triggering Attack and they cannot apply Stat Evasion 
against it. If the Target is Studied, the Triggering 
Combatant can use this Feature as a Free Action. 
Studied Weakness
Prerequisite: Chronicler, an Adept Chronicler Skill
Scene x 2 - Swift Action 
Trigger: You or your Pokemon hit a Flanked Enemy or would 
hit a Super Effective Attack against an Enemy
Effect: Targets of the Triggering Attack cannot use Reactions 
in response to it. If the Target is Studied, they become 
Vulnerable until the end of the Round.
Predictable
Prerequisite: Chronicler, 3 Chronicler Features, a Master 
Chronicler Skill
Scene - Free Action 
Trigger: You or your Pokemon are hit with an Attack
Effect: They resist the Triggering Attack by an additional 
Damage Step. Once per Scene, if the Triggering Attacker is 
Studied, you may choose to either not expend the Frequency 
of this Feature or instead cause the Attack to miss. 
Mechanic - Studied
Your Chronicler Features have a benefit when used against Enemies that are Studied. At the end of the Session, 
Enemies are no longer considered to be Studied, however if you cause the same Creature to become Studied at least 
three times over the course of a Campaign, they become permanently Studied in all future Encounters with them.  
(If you study 3 different Charmander , all Charmander become Studied)
At your GM’s Discretion, Creatures may be Studied as an Extended Action even if Combat hasn’t occurred, however the 
User must have either passed a Skill Check with the intent to learn more about the Target or spent a Downtime Action 
with the Target somehow (Such as Socializing or Training or even reading about the Target). This should not be used 
to start the Scene with a Creature Studied, but more to count towards the three times to permanent studied bonus 
without needing to get into a Combat Scene with them in addition to studying allies to interact with them better .
Illus. oka_mochi

title: Musician Songs
body:
Musician Songs
 

• Song of Despair - Enemies that start their Turn within your Zone of Song have a Penalty to  
Critical Hit Ranges, Effect Ranges and Save Checks equal to your Tier Level until the end of their Turn.  

• Song of Inspiration - The user and all Allies within your Zone of Song have a bonus to  
Save Checks and Effect Ranges equal to your Tier Level. 

• Song of Life - The user and all Allies within your Zone of Song restore Hit Points equal to their Tick Value when they end 
their Turn within your Zone of Song. If they already have Max Hit Points, they instead get a Tick of Temporary HP

• Song of Valor -The user and all allies have a bonus to Damage Rolls equal to your  
Tier Value while within the range of this Song.
Note - Your Musician Skills are - Gen Edu, Guile, Charm & Focus.
9292
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
MUSICIAN
Trainers who follow the path of a Musician come in many vocations 
and profession, though most adore the spirit of music. Whether as 
a musician or a vocalist, Musicians regal those around them with 
inspiring tales from journeys past or songs from the soul. 
Musician
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: General Researcher or Performer [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Musician Skill
At-Will - Swift Action 
Effect: You create a Zone of Song in a Burst 2 range centered 
on you. When the Zone is created, choose a song below to 
apply to all listed Combatants within this Zone. A Combatant 
cannot benefit from multiple Zones of Song. The chosen song 
can be changed as a Free Action at the start of your Turn. 
Whenever you use a Reaction, this Zone is removed. 
Bardic Influence
Prerequisite: Musician, an Adept Musician Skill
At-Will - Reaction
Trigger: An Ally within 5 m performs a Save Check, Skill Check 
in Combat or an Accuracy roll
Effect: The Triggering Ally adds a 1 d 6 to their Triggering Roll, 
or 2 d 6 if the user is Tier 3. 
Bonus: Once per Round you may use Bardic Influence as a 
Free Action if the Triggering Ally is within your Zone of Song.
Motivating Performance
Prerequisite: Musician, 3 Musician Features, a Master 
Musician Skill, an Adept Musician Skill
Scene x 3 - Free Action 
Trigger: An Ally starts their Turn within your Zone of Song
Effect: Choose an Effect to apply to the Triggering Ally:

• They gain +1 CS in a Stat of their Choice

• They gain the benefits of a different Song as well 

• They gain double the Effects of the Song played 
Tools for Tales
Prerequisite: Musician, two Novice Musician Skills
Static 
Effect: You learn the Attack Sing and Moral Support. 
While you have a Bardic Instrument Equipped, you 
have the following Attacks added to your Attack list, 
Echoed Voice and Uproar. When you have at least 
4 Musician Features, you also add Hyper Voice. 
When you have 5 Musician Features, you also add 
Boomburst.
Inspiring Presence
Prerequisite: Tools for Tales, an Expert Musician Skill, 
an Adept Musician Skill
Scene x 2 - Swift Action 
Trigger: You use a Sonic Attack
Effect: Choose an Ally or Enemy within the Range 
of the Triggering Attack. If you choose an Ally, 
they’re cured of a Mental Affliction. If you choose an 
Enemy, until the end of their next Turn, they become 
Entranced or Provoked A Combatant can only be 
affected by Inspiring Presence once per Scene.
Bonus: Your Attacks with the Sonic Keyword gain the 
Friendly keyword.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.93)
body:
9393
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
MEDICINE RESEARCHER
If not for medicine researchers, perhaps Pokemon fighting would be 
much more limited. However, thanks to modern medicine, potions may 
be crafted which have near instantaneous medical effects, allowing 
Medicine Researchers to be very benefitial to any adventuring party.
Medicine Researcher
[Base] [Class] 
Prerequisite: Novice Med Edu
Static 
Effect: Whenever you Use or Throw a Basic Healing Potion, 
you ignore the following restriction: “A Combatant cannot 
be Targeted by a Healing Potion more than once per Scene”. 
When you have at least 4 Medicine Researcher Features, this 
also extends to Greater Healing Potions. 
First Aid Training
Prerequisite: Medicine Researcher, Novice Med Edu
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: An Adjacent Ally
Effect: You may use the Help Maneuver on the Target 
as a Free Action. You may still use the Maneuver this 
way even if you used a Damaging Attack this Round 
and may still use one after the Maneuver resolves. An 
Ally can only be Targeted by First Aid Training once 
per Scene. 
Quick Fix
Prerequisite: Medicine Researcher, 2 Medicine 
Researcher Features, Expert Med Edu
Scene x 2 - Swift Action 
Effect: You may use a “Healing Potion” Item as a Free 
Action. A Combatant may only be Targeted by Quick 
Fix once per Scene and this can only Target Allies. 
Medicinal Mastery
Prerequisite: Medicine Researcher, Adept Med Edu
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: You use or Throw a “Potion” Item on yourself or a 
single Ally
Effect: Choose one of the following Effects to apply. This 
cannot be Triggered on Potions used through the Quick Fix 
Feature.

• The Target restores a Tick of Hit Points

• The Target is cured of a Status Affliction

• The Target gains Damage Reduction against the next Attack 
they’re hit by equal to your Tier Value. 
Stay With Us!
Prerequisite: Medicine Researcher, 3 Medicine Researcher 
Features, Master Med Edu
Scene - Reaction
Trigger: An Ally within 3 m would Faint
Effect: You may immediately Throw or Use a “Potion” Item 
on the Triggering Ally as a Free Action. If you plan to Use a 
“Potion”, you may Slide up to 3 m as a Free Action towards the 
intended Target. After resolving the condition that caused 
the Triggering Ally to Faint, they apply the Effects of the 
Potion, not being treated as Fainted yet. If they would end 
with an Hit Point value above 0, they are instead not Fainted 
from the Triggering condition.

title: Brewing Example
body:
Brewing Example
You cannot expend a Basic and Greater Healing Potion or a Basic 
and Greater Malady Potion. You also cannot expend two of the 
same Potion but with different effects such as a Basic Malady 
Potion (Paralyze) and Basic Malady Potion (Burn). You can however 
combine a Basic Strength Potion with a Greater Healing Potion. 
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
94
ALCHEMIST
Some Medical Researchers pursue the study of natural elements 
and chemicals in the pursuit of creating potions. Depending on 
the ingredients, the effects can vary wildly, however the pursuit of 
Alchemy is one that leads to wide flexibility and is near limitless.
Alchemist 
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Medicine Researcher [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Med Edu
Scene x 2 - Swift Action 
Effect: Choose any “Basic Potion” Item. You may instead 
choose a “Greater Potion” Item if you have at least 4 
Alchemist Features. Then apply any Effect below:

• You create the chosen Item and it is added to your 
Inventory, however, it is destroyed at the end of the Scene. 

• One Item in your Inventory that matches the declared Item 
cannot miss when next used with a Throw Maneuver.
Elemental Elixirs
Prerequisite: Alchemist, Adept Med Edu
Bind 2 - Extended Action 
Target: A “Potion” Item in your Inventory Slot that isn’t 
“Healing” and a Willing Pokemon 
Effect: Choose a Type that the Targeted Pokemon has. That 
Type is applied to the Targeted Item while this Feature is 
Bound. Whenever the Targeted Item is used in Combat, 
all Targets hit by the Item are treated as though they were 
hit with a Special Category Attack of the chosen Type. The 
Damage Base is equal to double your Med Edu Rank. Instead 
of an Offensive Stat, make a Medicine Edu Check and add 
that as a Damage Modifier. If you are Tier 3, add twice that 
result as a Damage Modifier. 
Experimental Brew
Prerequisite: Alchemist, 3 Alchemist Features, Master 
Med Edu
Scene x 2 - Full Action 
Effect: You may use a Throw Maneuver as a Free Action, 
however you may expend 2 different “Potion” Items when 
doing so, one being “Basic” and the other being either “Basic 
or Greater”. Their Effects are combined and both applied to 
the Target if they hit. The chosen Potions cannot have the 
same Name.
Caustic Chemistry
Prerequisite: Alchemist, Novice Med Edu 
Scene x 2 - Special 
Trigger: You use a Throw Maneuver with a 
“Potion” Item
Effect: As a Swift Action, the Range is changed to 
either X, Ranged Blast 2, or Close Blast 2. As a 
Swift+Movement Action, it is changed to either X, 
Ranged Blast 3, or Close Blast 3. X is equal to your 
Throwing Range as stated in the Throw Maneuver. 
Bonus: The Throw Maneuver’s AC is treated as 2 
when Throwing a “Potion” Item. 
Mutated Mixture
Prerequisite: Alchemist, 2 Alchemist Features, Expert 
Med Edu
Static 
Effect: Whenever you use a “Potion” Item listed 
below, you may instead treat their Effects as the 
following. An Enemy can only be affected by an Item 
adjusted this way once per Scene. 

• Healing Potion - The Target loses 2 d 3 Ticks of Hit 
Points and cannot restore HIt Points until the end of 
their next Turn. 

• Malady Potion - The Target is instead cured of the 
listed Affliction. 

• Strength or Vitality Potion - The Target instead 
has a negative Modifier or loses Combat Stages in 
the value specified by the potion. If the Target has a 
Negative Modifier this way, it is treated as a Physical 
Status Affliction that may be cured.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.95)
body:
9595
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
APOTHECARY
Some Trainers who research medicine go the more natural and herbal 
route compared to chemically processed. Apothecaries can either 
process poultices out of potions or find them naturally in the wild and 
use their wide array of curative properties to help their allies.
Apothecary
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Medicine Researcher [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Med Edu and Novice Nature Edu
Scene x 2 - Swift Action
Condition: You’re in an area with floral life
Effect: You gain 2 Simple Poultice. If you have Expert Nature 
Edu, you instead gain 2 Greater Poultice or 3 Simple Poultice.
Bonus: You gain the Herb Crafter Talent, even if you don’t 
qualify for it. Your “Poultice” Items are treated as “Healing 
Potions” for the sake of Triggers and Effects from Medicine 
Researcher.
Natural Variety
Prerequisite: Apothecary, Novice Med Edu or Nature 
Edu
Static
Effect: When using a Poultice as a Standard Action, 
you may choose any of the following Effects as well to 
apply instead of the listed ones.

• The Target gains a +2 Modifier to their choice of 
Accuracy or Save Checks for the rest of the Scene. If it 
is a Greater Poultice, they instead gain +3. 

• The Target gains +2 CS in a Stat of your Choice. If it 
is a Greater Poultice, they choose two Stats.

• The Target gains three Ticks of Temporary Hit 
Points. If it is a Greater Poultice, they also restore two 
Ticks of Hit Points.
Protective Salve
Prerequisite: Apothecary, 2 Apothecary Features, 
Expert Med Edu or Nature Edu
Scene x 2 - Full Action 
Target: Yourself or an Adjacent Ally
Effect: Expend a Poultice, then the Target gains a 
Salve Coat. While a Target is affected by a Salve 
Coat, they have +3 to Save Checks. The Target may 
expend the Salve Coat to benefit from the Poultice’s 
Effect or an Effect from the Natural Variety Feature. 
A Combatant may only gain a Salve Coat once per 
Scene. 
Botanical Purity
Prerequisite: Apothecary, Adept Med Edu or Nature Edu
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Target: Yourself or an Adjacent Ally
Effect: Expend a Poultice, then apply one of the following 
Effects to the Target.

• All Negative CS are reset to their Default CS Value

• One Coat is removed from the Target

• The Target is cured of a Status Affliction
Natural Remedies
Prerequisite: Apothecary, 3 Apothecary Features, 
Master Med Edu or Nature Edu
Scene - Swift Action 
Trigger: You use a Poultice 
Effect: The Effects of the Triggering Item do not apply 
immediately. At the start of your next Turn, the Poultice’s 
Effects apply, however any numerical values are doubled. If 
the Target is fainted, this Effect may still apply and revives 
them.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.96)
body:
9696
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
NATURE RESEARCHER
Trainers that follow the path of a nature researcher specialize in, well, 
being in nature. Their primary benefit is choosing a type of terrain to 
excel in, such as living in a Tundra for most of your live. When you do, 
you gain benefits from having lived there long specific to the terrain. 
Nature Researcher 
[Base] [Class] 
Prerequisite: Novice Nature Edu
Static 
Effect: When you gain this Feature, you gain the Naturewalk 
Capability with a Terrain of your choice. While you’re in 
Terrain that matches one of your Naturewalks, you gain a 
bonus to Accuracy Rolls equal to your Tier Level. (This bonus 
does not stack with itself)
Survival Instincts
Prerequisite: Nature Researcher, Adept Nature Edu
Scene - Reaction
Effect: You are cured of a Status Affliction. If you’re in Terrain 
that matches one of your Naturewalk Capabilities, this may 
also be used as a Swift Action 
Bonus: While you’re in Terrain that matches one of your 
Naturewalk Capabilities, you gain a bonus to Save Checks
equal to your Tier Level. (This bonus does not stack with 
itself)
Wild Adaptation
Prerequisite: Nature Researcher, 3 Nature Researcher 
Features, Master Nature Edu
Static 
Effect: Choose a Terrain listed on the next page for which 
you have the corresponding Naturewalk and gain the listed 
Ability. For each Naturewalk you have, you gain the listed 
Static Effect after the corresponding Terrain. 
Wild Adaptation Options are on the next page
Wild Trapper
Prerequisite: Nature Researcher, Novice Nature Edu
At-Will - Special 
Effect: As a Swift Action, choose up to 3 Unoccupied 
Spaces that are continuous with each other and start 
in an Adjacent Space to create one of the following 
Hazards in it. If you’re in Terrain that matches one of 
your Naturewalk Capabilities, you instead may choose 
up to 6 Spaces or use this as a Free Action once per 
Round. This may be used as an Extended Action to 
create a Trap that is a 3 x 3 Zone instead, which takes 
10 Minutes to set up. 
Wild Trapper Options are on the next page
Natural Connection
Prerequisite: Nature Researcher, 2 Nature Researcher 
Features, Expert Nature Edu
Bind 1 - Swift Action 
Target: An Allied Pokemon within 3 m of you
Effect: While you’re within 3 m of the Target, you’re 
treated as being in the Terrain(s) listed under its 
Naturewalk Capability for the sake of Effects.
Bonus: You gain the Naturewalk Capability with a

than normal Trainers. As such, their strength lies in the versatility of Items they 
can bring to an Encounter and additional Equipment space. As a GM, make sure 
your Nomad has regular access to items such as Potions or Hazard Bags or even

title: Esoteric Knowledge Examples
body:
Esoteric Knowledge Examples
1. My Character is a Ghost Type Specialist who took the Occult 
Researcher Class and the Empath Class as a result. Ghost Hunting 
is my specialty (Occult Study) so for my first Rank, I chose to resist 
Ghost Type Attacks and I coordinated with my GM to create a device 
that traps Ghost Types when used. For my second Rank, I gained the 
Telepath Capability but can only use it to communicate with Ghosts, 
and then I made a device that can make Ghosts Weakened for a Full 
Round when hit.
2. My Character is a Fighter, Monk and Occult Researcher who took 
the Aura Guardian Class as a result. Aura and Ki are my specialty 
(Occult Study) so for my first Rank, I chose to Resist Fighting Type 
Attacks and then I chose to gain the Illusionist Capability, as I can 
manifest my Aura visibly this way. For my second Rank I chose to 
gain the Tremorsense Capability as I can see Aura through objects, 
and whenever I make an opposed check for someone to notice my 
Aura Illusions, I roll twice, taking the higher result. 
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes

Having supernatural abilities doesn’t always come naturally. Some 
need to actually study the occult in order to gain an understanding 
of it and possibly gain powers. Those who do study it however gain a 
deeper understanding of the topic and end up being even stronger.

body:
Witchcraft Techniques
Hex of Delusion
Effect: If the Hexed Enemy becomes Dazed, they 
cannot Target their Allies with Attacks or Abilities and 
cannot perform Bolster Maneuvers as well. Whenever 
they become Cursed or Suppressed, you may instead 
have them become Dazed.
Curse: You gain Illusionist Capability for the Duration 
of this Curse but only the Target sees them.

Effect: If the Hexed Enemy becomes Entranced, you’re 
also treated as the Fixation. If you Entrance them, you 
may choose an additional Fixation for them to have. 
Whenever they become Cursed or Suppressed, you 
may instead have them become Entranced.
Curse: You have a Boon to Charm and Guile Checks 
against the Target for this duration. 
Hex of Foresight
Effect: Whenever the Hexed Enemy would Trigger an 
Effect that you or your Pokemon would need to use 
a Reaction to activate, it instead is a Free Action. You 
have a bonus to evasion against the Hexed Enemy 
equal to your Tier Level.
Curse: For this duration, you are treated as having 
the Premonition Capability but only regarding actions 
involving the Target.
Hex of Insight
Effect: You learn 3 facts about them from the GM 
which may include their knowledge of their Abilities, 
Attacks, Progression choices, Equipped Items, etc. 
This is treated as using the Analyze Maneuver.
Curse: For this duration, you are treated as having the 
Telepath Capability but only against the Target. If used 
as a Downtime Action, they ignore the 10 m range to 
the Capability.

Effect: The Hexed Enemy immediately becomes 
Enraged, however if they are cured of the Enraged 
Affliction, the Hexed Coat is also removed. While 
they’re Enraged this way, they cannot be cured of 
Afflictions other than Enraged. 
Curse: The Target’s mood becomes much more 
volatile and rash for this duration.
Hex of Sealing
Effect: If the Hexed Enemy becomes Suppressed, all 
of their Attack Frequencies are treated as one step 
higher (At-Will to EOT)l. Whenever they become 
Cursed, you may instead have them become 
Suppressed.
Curse: Choose a Capability you know the Target has 
to become disabled for this duration.
Hex of Weakness
Effect: While Hexed, choose a Type they currently 
resist or are Immune to. They treat the Effectiveness 
as Neutral instead. While they’re Hexed and affected 
by a Mental Affliction, they are Vulnerable
Curse: The Target has a Bane on all Skill Check for this 
Duration. 
GM Note - Researching new Witchcraft techniques can be a good reward for Players who 
take this Class! Have it be a Research Long Term Project and allow them to get custom 
curses or possibly hexes. Depending on the tone of your Campaign, the severity of the 
curses could differ but for the base system, they’re more tame.

GM Note - Field of Study
The number of Pokemon within this Category should be more than

warned that the larger a category is, the more versatile the class is. 
Example categories could include Pokemon with Swimmer, Dragon

title: Type Shift (X Points)
body:
When you create a Signature Attack, first, choose an Attack the Pokemon knows to become the baseline. The 
chosen Attack will be overwritten with any of the following modifications, also applying to their Versatile Effect 
if relevant. Then, determine how many Points you have to modify the Attack and choose any number of effects 
below to alter it. An Effect can be purchased multiple times. Signature Attacks modifiers are considered to be 
the Natural attributes of that Attack. 
Type Shift (X Points)
For 1 Point, the Attack is changed to match one of the user’s Types. For 3 Points, you may choose any 
Damaging Attack on their Tutor List and change it to that Type. 
Category Shift (2 Points)
If the Attack is Special, it becomes Physical. If it is Physical, it becomes Special. 
Frequency Shift (3 Points)
The Frequency is improved by one step. If it was Eo T, it becomes At-Will. If it was Scene, it gains +1 usage. 
Range Shift (3 Points)
Change the Range to any of the following or increase its existing Ao E by +1. If the Targeted Attack is Status, 
you can only increase its aoe this way. Melee, 1 Target | 6, 1 Target | Burst 1 | 3, Ranged Blast 2 | Line 3
Accuracy Shift (1 Point)
The AC of the Attack is lowered by -1, but cannot be lower than AC 2. 
Damage Shift (1 Point)
The DB of the Attack is increased by +1 but cannot exceed 4 plus double your Tier Level (Before STAB).
Effect Shift (X Points)
Add any Keyword below for its listed points cost. Your GM may also create custom effects for an appropriate 
points cost. > Drain (4), Friendly (3), Pass (3), Priority (2), Smite (2), Spirit Surge (3), Unstoppable (3)
 
Creating Signature Attacks
Examples

• A Froslass uses Spectral Flame as a baseline and uses type Shift to change it to Ice Type, which is 1 Point since they’re Iced Type. 
Their Points Budget was 4 so they ask the GM if they can have it become Chilled instead of Burned, which they deem to cost 3 
Points. They rename this new Signature Attack “Spectral Chill” .

• A Hydreigon uses Psychic Fangs as a baseline witha Points budget of 5. They category shift it to Special for 2 Points, They give it the 
Smite Keyword for 2. Then they lower it to 2 AC for 1 Point.
