and Recipient share at least one Type, you may choose 
an Ability the Donor knows. When the Recipient would 
learn an Ability through progression, they may choose to 
learn that one. 
Mutated Genome 
Prerequisite: Elemental Splicing, Expert Poke Edu or 
Med Edu
Scene x 2 - Swift Action 
Target: A Pokemon within 5 m with a Type that was 
altered by the Geneticist Feature 
Effect: One Attack or Pokemon Type altered this way is 
reverted to its original typing until the end of the Scene. 
Elemental Splicing
Prerequisite: Geneticist, Adept Poke Edu or Med Edu
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Target: An Adjacent Allied Pokemon 
Effect: Choose Two Attacks on the Target’s Attack List. Their 
Types are swapped until the end of the Scene. 
Bonus: When using the Geneticist Feature, you can choose 
an Attack that the Recipient knows. The Type of the Attack is 
changed to match one of the Donor’s Types, but it gains the Full 
Action Keyword, or Recoil 1/2 if it already has Full Action.
Adaptive Genetics
Prerequisite: Geneticist, Master Poke Edu or Med Edu
At-Will - Reaction 
Trigger: An Allied Pokemon within 3 m that is affected by 
Geneticist uses an Attack 
Effect: The Triggering Attack’s Type may be changed to match 
one of the user’s Types. This is considered to be the Attack’s 
Natural Type, ignoring rules. 
Bonus: When using the Geneticist Feature, you can choose a 
Type that the Donor has. The Recipient can either gain that Type 
if they only had one, or replaces one of their existing Types with 
the chosen one. 
Class Note
You can generally transfer non mechanical traits at any time without counting towards this limit. This could be 
transferring the sparkiness of a flaaffy onto the fur of an eevee. As a GM, if you enable this class, it should be done with 
heavy supervision to prevent overpowered combinations. Communicate with your players if you feel like a combination 
is too strong or you aren’t confident with your intuition on balance. The class’s purpose is to enable the creation of 
unique Variant Pokemon but of course, this comes with a high risk of imbalance outcomes, so it is completely fine to 
ban this class if desired. When enabling this class, you should also coordinate with your Player on how they fluff these 
mechanics, as some may not like what is essentially Pokemon eugenics even if it’s fluffed as being a breeder . 
Note - Signature Traits are Traits where only one species line naturally learns it, like Unanimaus learned by Tandemause
Illus. Evolution_ygo

limitless, and Trainers who pursue this line of research know this first

Static

Gadgets Feature. You gain a custom Item with the [Trinket]

Novice Tech Edu

Expert Tech Edu

body:
109109
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
Shard Versatility
Prerequisite: Artificer, Novice Occult Edu or Tech Edu
At-Will - Special 
Trigger: An Ally within 3 m would meet a Trigger 
Condition of a Shard
Effect: Expend a Shard of the corresponding Color and 
apply its Effect to the Triggering Ally. Shard Versatility 
is a Free Action but can also be used as a Reaction to 
double numerical values in the Shard’s Effect. 
Bonus: Your Shards gain additional Effects listed 
below:

• If the holder would be hit by an Attack that 
corresponds to one of the Shard’s Types, they gain 
Damage Reduction against it equal to your Tier Value

• If the holder would use an Attack that corresponds 
to one of the Shards Types, they gain Accuracy for it 
equal to your Tier Level
Crystal Imbuement
Prerequisite: Artificer, 2 Artificer Features, Expert 
Occult Edu or Tech Edu
Scene x 3 - Free Action
Trigger: You or an Ally within 5 m uses an Attack
Effect: Expend a Shard from your Inventory, then 
select one of its associated Types. The Triggering 
Attack is treated as if it were the chosen Type. If the 
Triggering Combatant is holding a Type Augmentor, 
Type Booster or Type Brace, you may have it be 
treated as the associated Item’s Type instead of 
expending a Shard.
Gem Flux
Prerequisite: Artificer, Adept Occult Edu or Tech Edu
At-Will - Swift Action 
Target: You or an Adjacent Ally with an equipped 
Type Augmentor, Type Booster or Type Brace
Effect: Expend a Shard from your Inventory and choose one 
of its associated Types. The Targeted Item is treated as if it 
were that Type instead until the end of the Scene. 
Bonus: You may treat the “Shard” Item as if it had the 
[Resource] Keyword.
Prismatic Power
Prerequisite: Artificer, 3 Artificer Features, Master Occult Edu 
or Tech Edu
Scene x 2 - Standard Action 
Trigger: A listed Trigger below occurs
Effect: Expend a Shard from your Inventory that corresponds 
to the Trigger, then apply its effect.

• Red - When an Ally uses a Physical Attack it automatically 
hits and is one step more effective (Max 1.5 x)

• Orange - When an Ally is hit by a Physical Attack, it instead 
misses and they suffer no effects of the Attack.

• Yellow - When an Ally is hit by an Attack and isn’t Fainted, 
they restore 5 Ticks of Hit Points.

• Green - When an Ally gains a Status Affliction, it is 
automatically cured. 

• Blue - When an Ally uses a Special Attack it automatically 
hits and is one step more effective (Max 1.5 x)

• Violet - When an Ally is hit by a Special Attack, it instead 
misses and they suffer no effects of the Attack.
ARTIFICER
Artificers are Trainers who are fascinated by the phenomena of ‘Type 
Shards’ which are located underground. These shards harness the 
power of Elemental Types and can be harnessed by those with enough 
knowledge to be a great asset in battle and a tool of great versatility.
Artificer
[Advanced] [Class]
Prerequisite 1: Occult Researcher or Tech Researcher [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Occult Edu or Tech Edu
At-Will - Special 
Effect: You create a Shard and add it to an open Inventory 
Slot. If used as a Swift Action, its color is chosen instead of 
randomized. If used as a Free Action, it is randomized as 
normal. Artificer may only be used once per Round. 
Bonus: You gain the Artificing Kit and grant it the [Trinket] 
Keyword. During Crafting Downtime Actions you may create 
Type Augmentors, Type Boosters and Type Braces. Each Shard 
you have can be used as if they were 5 “Ingredient” Items for 
Artificer Recipes, however their associated Type must match 
the crafted Item.
Shard Types - Red (Fire, Fairy, Psychic), Orange (Normal, Fighting, 
Dragon), Yellow (Electric, Rock, Steel), Green (Bug, Grass, 
Ground), Blue (Flying, Ice, Water), Violet (Dark, Ghost, Poison)

title: Mechanic - Adrenaline Tokens
body:
Mechanic - Adrenaline Tokens 
Adrenaline Tokens are gained whenever you perform an action deemed risky by the GM. After the check is performed 
you gain 1 Adrenaline Token, or 2 if the result was negative. Actions are not deemed risky unless there is a decent 
chance of failure, have a penalty attached, or have a degree of uncertainty of its results. Adrenaline Tokens may be 
expended to add a d 6 to any non-Education Skill Check, Accuracy Check, Luck Check or Save Check for each token 
expended. No more than 2 Tokens may be spent on a singular usage. You can only have a Maximum of 6 Adrenaline 
Tokens at a time.
 
Example - A Daredevil that Intercepts an Attack from a Minion or resisted Attack is not reckless. Intercepting an Attack 
that’s strong or a Critical Hit would grant a Token.
Example - A Daredevil uses an explosive device to trigger an explosion on an oil barrel. He doesn’t know the extent of 
what could happen, this would grant a Token. 
117117

below. When you have 4 Daredevil Features, choose 
two more to learn.

Wide Guard

Effect: The Triggering Combatant performs a Luck Check. On a

becomes a Critical Hit which cannot be prevented or avoided 
by any means. You may use Adrenaline Tokens to grant a 1 d 4 
penalty to their Luck Check if desired. If the usage of this 
feature leads you to miss an attack or an enemy landing a 
critical hit, you gain an Adrenaline Token
Daredevil
[Adv] [Class]

Prerequisite 2: Adept Combat or Intuition

If it was 5 or less, it is instead a major setback.

Actions.
Trainers who like to live on the edge follow the path of a daredevil. 
Performers that thrive off adrenaline and seek risks can’t see any 
other lifestyle than one on the edge. Daredevils excel at putting 
themselves in danger for big rewards or big losses.
DAREDEVIL

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.118)
body:
118118
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
Sly Mimicry
Prerequisite: Imposter, Adept Guile or Stealth
At-Will - Swift Action 
Target: A Combatant within 5 m 
Effect: Choose an Attack that the Target has used 
in this Scene. This Attack is added to your Attack 
list until the end of the Scene or until you use this 
Feature again. The Frequency of Attacks carries over 
even if replaced. 
Bonus: Whenever you use Damaging Attacks that you 
didn’t start the Scene with on your Attack List, they 
may be treated as either Physical or Special Category 
of your choice.
 
Art of Deception
[Ranked 3]
Rank 1 Prerequisite: Imposter
Rank 2 Prerequisite: Imposter, Expert Guile or Stealth
Rank 3 Prerequisite: Imposter, Master Guile or Stealth
Static 
Effect: Choose two Imposter Techniques to gain from the list 
on the next page. 
 
Imposter
[Adv] [Class]
Prerequisite 1: Performer or Provocateur [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Guile or Stealth
Static 
Effect: You gain the Makeshift Artisan Talent. You may craft 
[Small] and [Large] Disguises. You learn the Copycat Attack. 
Performers that are masters of disguise and conmen tend to follow 
the path of an Imposter. Masters of the Masquerade, Imposter 
specialize in wearing disguises, having multiple identities and even 
copying attacks used by their enemies and allies supernaturally.
IMPOSTER

title: Donned Disguise
body:
Donned Disguise 
Bind 1 - Extended Action 
Target: A [Small] Disguise you own
Effect: While bound to this Feature, the Target 
Item gains the [Trinket] Keyword. When you have 4 
Imposter Features you may instead Target a [Large] 
Disguise you own.
Voice Training
Static 
 Effect: As a TN 15 Downtime Research Action 
(Uses Guile or Stealth for the default skill), you may 
permanently learn to mimic the voice of any specific 
Pokemon or Person you have heard. With a CR 4 Guile 
or Stealth Check, you may learn to mimic a voice until 
the end of a Scene, not needing a Downtime Action. 
Enemies have no reason to suspect that your mimic’d 
voice is unauthentic, if successful. 
Armored Apparel
Bind 1 - Extended Action 
Target: A Disguise you own; An [Armor] Item of the 
same size
Effect: While this Technique is bound, the Targeted 
Disguise Item also has the Effect of the Targeted 
[Armor] Item. 
 
 
Costume Change
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Target: Yourself or an Adjacent Ally 
Effect: The Target may unequip any number of Items 
in their Equipment Slot and add them to their or your 
Inventory. The Target may then equip any number of 
non-Weapon Items from their Inventory or yours
Memorized Tactics
Bind 2 - Extended Action 
Trigger: You perform a Training Downtime Action on 
yourself 
Target: A Willing Ally
Effect: Choose up to two At-Will or EOT Attacks that 
the Target knows and add them to your Attack list or 
swap them out with any Bound Attacks you learned 
this way previously. You may only have up to 2 
Attacks learned this way on your Attack List at a time.
Illusory Tactics
Static 
Effect: You learn the Double Team Attack. Whenever 
you use its Versatile Effect, the Frequency is ignored 
and not expended. 
 
I’m You But Better
At-Will - Reaction 
Trigger: An Enemy Targets you with an Attack 
Effect: The Triggering Attack is added to your Attack 
list until the end of the Scene. 
Bonus: Whenever you add an Attack to your Attack 
List, you may mark the source with a Mimic Mark. 
Whenever you Attack an Enemy with a Mimic Mark 
with an Attack you gained from them, they cannot 
apply Evasion against it. 
 
Imposter Techniques

120120
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
DEFENDER
The classic tank characters should look towards being a Defender 
when picking a class, as it provides many generic defensive tools 
that Trainers could benefit from such as better intercepting, better 
defending and being better at making enemies attack you over allies.
Defender
[Base] [Class] 
Prerequisite: Novice Athletics or Combat
Static 
Effect: When using the Defend Maneuver, you may Target 
any number of Adjacent Allies to benefit from its Effect. You 
may learn two Attacks from the Defensive Combat Feature’s 
Novice Attack List.
Instinctive Defense
Prerequisite: Defender, Adept Athletics or Combat
Static 
Effect: You gain the Durable Protector General Feature. You 
may use the Intercept Maneuver as if it was a Swift Action or 
Reaction.
Impenetrable Fortress
Prerequisite: Defender, 3 Defender Features, Master Athletics 
or Combat
Scene - Standard Action 
Effect: You gain a Fortified Coat. While you’re affected by 
a Fortified Coat, you resist the next two Damaging Attacks 
you’re hit by for an additional damage step. The Fortified 
Coat is expended after Damage Resolution when you’re hit by 
a second Damaging Attack since gaining this Coat. 
Draw Aggro
Prerequisite: Defender, Novice Athletics or Combat
Static 
Effect: Whenever you use the Provoke Maneuver, 
you may also use it as if its Range were “All Adjacent 
Enemies”. Whenever you Provoke an Enemy, it is 
treated as a Mental Affliction instead of a Condition 
and must be cured, removing any listed time 
durations. 
Defensive Tactics
Prerequisite: Defender, 2 Defender Features, Expert 
Athletics or Combat
Static 
Effect: Choose a listed Defensive Tactic to gain its 
associated Ability in the parenthesis. 

• Armored (Battle Armor), Bulky (Absorb Force), 
Guardian (Friend Guard), Protective (Bodyguard), 
Stoic (Stoicism)

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.121)
body:
121121
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
BULWARK
Defenders that are a master at field control end up as a Bulwark. 
Bulwark trainers specialize in crowd control, being able to provoke 
and trap enemies and manipulate the field by creating obstructions 
that can be used to block attacks or mitigate damage. 
Bulwark
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Defender [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Athletics or Focus
At-Will - Standard Action 
Effect: You create Large Blocking or Cover Terrain in up to 3 
unoccupied adjacent spaces. Terrain Created this way is also 
[Fragile & Breakable]. Whenever you or an Ally are adjacent 
to this Terrain, they have Damage Reduction equal to your 
Tier Value (This does not stack with itself). If you have 4 
Bulwark Features you may use this as a Swift or Movement 
Action as well, but only choose 1 unoccupied adjacent space 
instead.
Crowd Control
Prerequisite: Bulwark, Novice Athletics or Focus
At-Will - Special
Target: An Enemy within 3 m or all Adjacent Enemies 
Effect: If this is used as a Swift Action, apply one 
of the following to the Target(s). If this is used as a 
Standard Action, instead apply all of the following. 

• They are Provoked by you until the end of their 
next Turn.

• They are Trapped by you until the end of the 
next Round.

• You resist the next Damaging Attack from all Targets 
by an additional damage step until the end of the 
next Round.
Fortified Rampart
Prerequisite: Bulwark, 2 Bulwark Features, Expert 
Athletics or Focus
Scene - Special
Trigger: An Ally adjacent to Blocking or Cover Terrain 
you created would be hit by an Attacker who isn’t 
adjacent to them 
Target: A Blocking or Cover Terrain you created that is 
Adjacent to the Triggering Ally 
Effect: The Ally is instead not hit by the Triggering 
Attack, nor do they take damage or are affected by 
its Effects. The Targeted Terrain is then destroyed. 
This Feature may be used as a Standard Action or 
Reaction. If used as a Standard Action, its Frequency 
is not expended.
Stalwart Bastion
Prerequisite: Bulwark, Adept Athletics or Focus
Static 
Effect: You gain 5 Damage Reduction. When you reach Tier 
2+, this is increased to 10 Damage Reduction. While an Ally is 
adjacent to you, they also have this Damage Reduction. Your 
[Equipment - Armor] Items cannot be affected by the Disarm 
Maneuver.
Steelclad Fortress
Prerequisite: Bulwark, 3 Bulwark Features, Master Athletics 
or Focus
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: You or an Adjacent Ally would be hit by a 
Damaging Attack
Effect: When calculating the damage of the Triggering Attack, 
you and all allied Combatants that were hit are considered 
to be Steel Type for the sake of calculating Weaknesses and 
Resistances.

title: Cover Terrain - If a Ranged Attack would Target a Combatant
body:
Cover Terrain - If a Ranged Attack would Target a Combatant 
adjacent to Cover Terrain it is resisted by an additional damage 
step unless the Attacker is either Adjacent to the Target or this 
Cover Terrain. Cover Terrain must have a size designated and can 
only provide cover to Combatants of equal or smaller size, such 
as a Bush not providing cover for a Rhydon. 
122122
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
JUGGERNAUT
Defensive Trainers that refuse to faint are often known as 
Juggernauts, sometimes lovingly referred to as Behemoths. 
Juggernauts excel in having a massive durable body that can 
withstand a lot of damage and recover from anything thrown at them. 
Juggernaut 
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Defender [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Athletics or Combat
Static 
Effect: You gain +5 Stat Points in HP . When you have 3 
Juggernaut Features, you gain an additional +5. When you 
have 5 Juggernaut Features, you gain an additional +10. Stat 
Points gained this way go in the Extras Column. You start the 
Scene with a Tick of Temporary Hit Points. 
Built Different
Prerequisite: Juggernaut, Novice Athletics or Combat
Static 
Effect: Allies that are Adjacent to you treat you as 
if you were Cover Terrain and Enemies cannot pass 
through spaces you’re occupying. The User may shift 
through Spaces occupied by Enemies as if they were 
Basic Terrain but cannot occupy their space at the 
end of their Movement. If you are Targeted by a Line 
Attack, its Range stops at you and it cannot exceed to 
any further space. 
Resilient Recovery
Prerequisite: Juggernaut, 2 Juggernaut Features, 
Expert Athletics or Combat
At-Will - Swift Action or Reaction 
Trigger: You start your Turn or are hit by an Attack
Effect: You gain a Tick of Temporary Hit Points. If the 
Trigger was being hit by an Attack, this occurs after 
the Triggering Attack resolves. 
Overwhelming Might
Prerequisite: Juggernaut, Adept Athletics or Combat
At-Will - Swift Action 
Trigger: You hit with a Melee Attack 
Effect: You may use your Adjusted HP Stat Total (not Hit 
Points) as an Offensive Stat when calculating the Damage 
Roll for this Attack or add your Tick Value as a Damage Bonus 
instead.
Indomitable Body
Prerequisite: Juggernaut, 3 Juggernaut Features, Master 
Athletics or Combat
Scene - Special 
Effect: As a Swift Action, choose one of the Effects to apply. 
As a Full Action, all are applied. 

• You are cured of a Physical Affliction

• You restore three Ticks of Hit Points

• You gain two Ticks of Temporary Hit Points 
Bonus: Once per Scene, when you fall below 25% Hit Points, 
the Frequency of this Feature is refreshed.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.123)
body:
123123
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
SENTINEL
Defenders that dont’ seek to just be tanky for themselves, end up 
following the path of a Sentinel. These Trainers are much more self 
sacrficing and built to protect others and deal back revenge when 
their allies are harmed, often using defense as their strength. 
Sentinel
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Defender [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Combat or Command
At-Will - Free Action
Trigger: You use Damaging Attack against an Enemy that is 
Provoked by you or an Attack of Opportunity
Effect: If the Triggering Attack is Physical, you use your Defense 
as the Offensive Stat instead of Attack. If the Triggering Attack 
is Special, you use your Special Defense as the Offensive Stat 
instead of Special Attack.
Bonus: When your Attack of Opportunity is Triggered, you may 
use a Swift Action or a Reaction to use it. An Enemy can only 
Trigger your Attack of Opportunity once per Round.
Stand Behind Me
Prerequisite: Sentinel, Novice Combat or Command
Static
Effect: Whenever you use the Defend Maneuver, the 
Targets resist Blast and Line Attacks by an additional 
Damage Step while they’re adjacent to you for this 
duration. Whenever an Adjacent Ally under the Effect 
of your Defend Maneuver would move, you may slide 
into a space that is Adjacent to them. This cannot let 
you move more spaces than your Movement Value. 
Retaliating Force
Prerequisite: Sentinel, 2 Sentinel Features, Expert 
Combat or Command
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: You Intercept an Attack or an Adjacent Enemy 
Targets an Ally with an Attack
Effect: After the Trigger resolves, you may use an 
At-Will Attack as a Free Action, with the Triggering 
Enemy being the only Target, provided they’re in 
range, however it is resisted by an additional step. 
This is treated as an Attack of Opportunity for the 
sake of the Sentinel Feature. At Tier 3, you may 
instead choose an At-Will or EOT Attack.
Get Down!
Prerequisite: Sentinel, Adept Combat or Command
Scene - Free Action 
Trigger: You Intercept for an Ally and they would still be hit by 
the Intercepting Area of Effect Attack
Effect: The Ally you Intercepted for is slid up to 3 m instead 
of into an Adjacent Space. If they slide into a Space that isn’t 
in the original range of the Attack, it misses them instead of 
dealing damage as if they resisted it by an additional damage 
step.
Sacrificial Heart
Prerequisite: Sentinel, 3 Sentinel Features, Master Combat or 
Command
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: An Ally within 2 m is Attacked
Effect: You may use the Intercept Maneuver against the 
Triggering Attack as a Free Action. 
Bonus: You learn the Endure Attack

124124
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
FIGHTER
Fighters are trainers that have basic martial combat knowledge in 
close range quarters. Whether with weapons or with fists, fighters 
excel at fighting others and even standing up to other Pokemon with 
only their strength to use against them. 
Fighter
[Base] [Class]
Prerequisite: Novice Athletics or Combat
At-Will - Extended Action 
Effect: Choose a Stat to become your Trained Stat (You can 
only have one at a time). Your Trained Stat has their Default 
CS Value set to +1. If you chose HP , you instead start the 
Scene with 2 Ticks of Temporary Hit Points. 
Bonus: You may learn two Attacks from the Martial Combat 
Feature’s Novice Attack List.
Close Combat
Prerequisite: Fighter, Novice Athletics or Combat
Scene x 2 - Free Action
Trigger: You use a Melee Attack
Effect: The Triggering Attack is treated as having no 
effect, but apply one of the following:

• After the Attack’s Resolution, you may perform one 
of the following Maneuvers against the Target using 
a Reaction. The Maneuver automatically hits but still 
needs an opposed check if necessary: Trip, Push, 
Hinder, Disarm, Distract or Provoke.

• This Attack ignores the Physical Evasion of 
all Targets.

• After the Attack’s Resolution, the Target loses -2 CS 
in Defense or Special Defense. 
Martial Style
Prerequisite: Fighter, 2 Fighter Features, Expert 
Athletics or Combat
Static 
Effect: Choose a listed Martial Style to gain its 
associated Ability in the parenthesis. 

• Agile (Vanguard), Brutal (Huge Power), 
Guarded (Absorb Force), Nimble (Combo Striker), 
Ruthless (Vicious)
Martial Prowess
Prerequisite: Fighter, Adept Athletics or Combat
Scene x 2 - Free Action
Trigger: You would use a Riposte or Tactic Maneuver
Effect: Choose one effect to apply. 

• The Triggering Maneuver automatically hits the Target. 

• All Targets of the Triggering Maneuver fail their 
opposed check. 
Bonus: Once per Round you may use any Tactic Maneuver 
(Other than Throw) as if it were a Free Action, but you must 
expend 1 SP to do so. (It still must be Triggered)
Combat Momentum
Prerequisite: Fighter, 3 Fighter Features, Master Athletics 
or Combat
At-Will - Free Action 
Trigger: You roll a natural 15+ on a Melee Attack or cause an 
Enemy to faint with a Melee Attack 
Effect: After the Trigger resolves, choose one of the following 
effects to apply:

• You gain +1 CS in your Trained Stat (1 Tick of Temporary HP 
if it’s HP)

• Your next Melee Attack ignores Stat Evasion

• You gain an additional Movement Action. For the rest 
of your Turn, Movement does not trigger Attacks of 
Opportunity.
Bonus: Your Trained Stat’s Default CS Value is increased by +1 
or you start the scene with 3 Ticks of Temporary Hit Points if 
it is HP .

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.125)
body:
125125
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
BERSERKER
Fueled by fury and rage, Berserkers are fighters that are full blown 
fighters. These Trainers can specialize in their rage to ramp up in 
power, fight past their limits or deal insane damage. In addition they can 
build up fury and pain in order to recover or deal even more damage.
Berserker
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Fighter [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Combat and Novice Intimidate
At-Will - Free Action 
Trigger: You’re hit with an Attack or hit a Damaging Attack
Effect: After the Triggering Attack resolves, you gain a Fury 
Counter (Max 6).
Bonus: For each Fury Counter you have, your Critical Hit 
Range is increased by +1. Whenever you land a Critical Hit, all 
Fury Counters are expended. You learn the Rage Attack.
Reckless Strike
Prerequisite: Berserker, Novice Combat or Intimidate
At-Will - Free Action 
Trigger: You miss a Melee Attack 
Effect: You may perform the Accuracy Roll again. You 
cannot use anything requiring a Reaction until the 
start of your next Turn. 
Bonus: While Enraged, your Actions are not restricted 
by the Affliction’s Effects
Embodiment of Rage
Prerequisite: Berserker, 2 Berserker Features, Expert 
Combat or Intimidate
Static 
Effect: You cannot become Provoked as a result of the 
Enraged Affliction. In addition, choose a listed Rage 
Style to gain its associated Ability in the parenthesis. 

• Enduring (Enduring Rage), Feral (Berserk), Wrathful 
(Anger Point). 
Power from Pain
Prerequisite: Berserker, Adept Combat or Intimidate
Static 
Effect: While Enraged or Provoked, your Damaging Attacks 
have their Damage Base increased by +X for every two Ticks 
of Hit Points you’re missing. X is equal to your Tier Level. 
Example: If your Tick value is 10 and you’re at 70 Hit Points 
out of 100, you’re missing three Ticks. If you use a DB 6 
Attack, this increases it by +2 (If you’re Tier 2)
Fueled by Fury
Prerequisite: Berserker, 3 Berserker Features, Master Combat 
or Intimidate
Scene x 2 - Swift Action 
Effect: You may expend any number of Fury Counters. You 
then gain X Ticks of Temporary Hit Points, where X is the 
number of Counters expended. 
Bonus: Whenever you’re hit by a Critical Hit, you may expend 
3 Fury Counters to treat it as a normal hit instead.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.126)
body:
126126
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
GLADIATOR
Trainers that follow the path of the Gladiator live for the glory of battle. 
They’re not simply street brawlers but they’re more entertainers and 
win a fight in style. Through the Glory mechanic, Gladiators can ramp 
up their power in a Scene based on their performance.
Gladiator
[Advanced] [Class]
Prerequisite 1: Fighter [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Combat and Novice Charm or Command
At-Will - Free Action 
Trigger: You Provoke an Enemy, land a Critical hit, an Attack 
misses you, or you or your Pokemon cause an Enemy to faint 
Effect: You gain +1 Glory Counter. For each Glory Counter you 
have, you have a +1 Modifier to Accuracy for Melee Attacks. 
Whenever your Pokemon Faint, you lose half of your Glory 
Counters (Rounded Down). You cannot have more Glory Counters 
than double your Tier Level.
Bonus: You learn the Taunt Attack.
Rising Glory
Prerequisite: Gladiator, Novice Combat, Novice 
Charm or Command
Static 
Effect: You gain the following benefits while you don’t 
have a Mental Affliction:

• You have a +5 Bonus to Damage Rolls multiplied by 
your current Glory Counters. At Tier 3, this changes to 
a +10 bonus.

• You have 5 Damage Reduction multiplied by your 
Glory Counters against Attacks derived from Enemies 
that are Provoked by you.

• You have a +1 bonus to Evasion against Enemies 
Provoked by you multiplied by your current Glory 
Counters.
Flaunting Glory
Prerequisite: Gladiator, 2 Gladiator Features, Expert 
Combat, Adept Charm or Command
Scene x 2 - Swift Action 
Effect: You may expend up to 2 Glory Counters and 
choose an effect below to apply for each Counter 
expended. (They can be the same Effect)

• Choose an Enemy within 5 m to become Provoked 
by you for a until the end of their next Turn. This 
cannot Trigger the Gladiator Feature.

• Gain +1 CS in a Stat of your choice.

• An Enemy within 5 m that has a Mental Affliction 
suffers a -3 to their next Save Check.
Calling all Challengers
Prerequisite: Gladiator, Adept Combat, Novice Charm 
or Command
Static 
Effect: You learn the Regal Challenge Ability. If you Provoke 
at least 3 Combatants through this Ability, you instead gain 
+2 Glory Counters if you Triggered Gladiator through it. You 
may use Taunt through the Versatile Keyword even if you use 
a Damaging Attack during your Turn and can use a Damaging 
Attack even if you used Taunt through the Versatile Keyword 
this Turn. 
Star of the Show
Prerequisite: Gladiator, 3 Gladiator Features, Master Combat, 
Adept Charm or Command
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: You hit, or are hit by, an Enemy who’s 
Provoked by you 
Effect: If the Trigger was being hit by a Provoked Enemy, you 
resist the Triggering Attack by an additional Damage Step. If 
the Trigger was hitting a Provoked Enemy, the Attack becomes 
a Critical Hit. An Enemy can only be affected by Star of the 
Show once per Scene.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.127)
body:
127127
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
Flurry of Blows
Prerequisite: Monk, Novice Combat or Athletics
At-Will - Swift Action 
Trigger: You miss a Melee Attack
Effect: You perform the Accuracy Roll again. If the 
Attack hits, it is resisted by an additional damage 
step, cannot be a Critical Hit and cannot trigger Effect 
Ranges. If you have at least 4 Monk Features and the 
rerolled Attack misses, you may roll it once more.
Stunning Strike
Prerequisite: Monk, 2 Monk Features, Expert Combat 
or Athletics
Scene x 2 - Swift Action
Trigger: You roll a Natural 15+ on a Damaging Melee 
Attack against a Single Enemy 
Effect: The Effect of the Triggering Attack is ignored. 
If it was a Critical Hit, it is no longer a Critical Hit. 
Choose one of the following Effects to apply to the 
Target. A Target can only be affected by Stunning 
Strike once per Scene. 

• They become Paralyzed

• They become Dazed

• They become Weakened until the end of their next 
Turn

• They become Vulnerable until the end of the Round
Purity of Body & Mind
Prerequisite: Monk, Adept Combat or Athletics
Static 
Effect: Upon gaining this Feature, choose Body or Mind. If 
you choose Body, while you’re affected by a Physical Status 
Affliction, you may perform Save Checks twice, taking the 
higher result. If you choose Mind, while you’re affected by a 
Mental Status Affliction, you may perform Save Checks twice, 
taking the higher result. If you have 5 Monk Features, you 
benefit from both instead. 
Damage Deflection
Prerequisite: Monk, 3 Monk Features, Master Combat or 
Athletics
Scene x 2 - Reaction
Trigger: You’re hit by a Damaging Attack
Effect: Choose one of the Effects below to apply. Each effect 
may only be applied once per Scene:

• You resist it by an additional Damage Step. Then your next 
Damaging Attack gains the Smite Keyword.

• You resist it by an additional Damage Step. An Enemy within 
2 m is also hit by the Triggering Attack but resists it by an 
additional Damage Step.

• If the Triggering Attack wasn’t from an Adjacent Enemy, it 
misses instead. 
Monk
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Fighter [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Combat and Novice Athletics 
At-Will - Free Action 
Trigger: You start your Turn 
Effect: Choose a Stance below to enter. You benefit from the 
Stance’s effects until you enter a new stance or the Scene ends. 

• Ferocious Stance - You have a bonus to the Damage Rolls for 
Melee Attacks equal to your Tier Value.

• Defensive Stance - You have Damage Reduction against 
Physical Attacks equal to your Tier Value

• Flowing Stance - Your Movement Value is increased by +3 and 
you do not provoke Attacks of Opportunity by moving.

• Meditative Stance - You have a bonus to Save Checks and 
Evasion equal to your Tier Level. 
While other Fighter classes are usually solely offensive, Monk 
Trainers focus on durability and versatility. When they desire, they can 
empower themselves to have brutal strikes or stunning strikes, but 
they can also have a mastery of body and mind, having sustainability.
MONK

title: Mystic Attack Reference
body:
Mystic Attack Reference 
Basic Arcane Weapon Attacks - Arcane Fury, Bane, Energy Blast, 
Healing Aura, Rending Spell, Resonance Beam 
Advanced Arcane Weapon Attacks - Empowerment, Missile Shot, 
Magical Burst, Mirror Coat, Mystic Ward, Shield
Psionic Combat Novice Attacks - Calm Mind, Cosmic Power, Light 
Screen, Reflect, Safeguard 
Psionic Combat Expert Attacks - Barrier, Imprison, Heal Pulse, 
Hypnosis, Kinesis, Mirror Coat
128128
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
Arcane Alteration
Prerequisite: Mystic, Novice Occult Edu or Focus
Scene x 3 - Swift Action 
Trigger: You use a Special Attack 
Effect: Apply a Mystic Technique to the Triggering 
Attack.
Note: Amplified Sorcery is the only Technique that 
can be applied to an Attack and stack its effects with 
itself. Other Techniques do not stack.
Mystical Style
Prerequisite: Mystic, 2 Mystic Features, Expert Occult 
Edu or Focus
Static 
Effect: Choose a Mystical Style to gain its associated 
Ability in parenthesis. 

• Archaic (Sorcery), Overflowing (Magical Surge), 
Tactical (Mental Force), Warding (Magic Guard), 
Willpower (Mysticism)
Channeled Mysticism
Prerequisite: Arcane Alteration, Adept Occult Edu or Focus
At-Will - Reaction
Trigger: An Ally within 3 m uses a Special Attack 
Effect: Apply a Mystic Technique to the Triggering Attack. 
Magical Mastery
Prerequisite: Arcane Alteration, Master Occult Edu or Focus
Bind 2 - Extended Action 
Target: A Special Attack you know and a Mystic Technique
Effect: While the Targeted Attack is bound by this Feature, 
they may choose to apply the targeted Mystic Technique as a 
At-Will - Free Action whenever it is used. 
Mystic
[Base] [Class]
Prerequisite: Novice Occult Edu or Focus 
Static 
Effect: You learn two Basic Weapon Attacks with the 
Requirement of [Arcane] Only or two Attacks from the Psionic 
Combat Features’ Novice Attack List or one Attack from each 
list. When you have 4 Mystic Features, you learn two more 
from the Advanced Weapon list with the same requirement 
or from the Psionic Combat Features Expert Attack List. 
Weapon Attacks learned this way can be used through a 
qualifying Weapon as if it was granted through them or as if 
the Weapon Range was 6 and usable without a Weapon. 
Compared to Occult Researchers, some Trainers have innate mystical 
abilities. While Fighters are pros at all things physical, Mystics are 
on the opposite side, mastering everything special and magical. The 
specialty of Mystics lay in their Mystic Techniques, altering their attacks.
MYSTIC

title: MYSTIC TECHNIQUES
body:
MYSTIC TECHNIQUES
Fated Spark
Effect: The Triggering Attack cannot be Intercepted, 
Riposted, and Targets cannot Trigger any Effect that 
would cause them to resist the Triggering Attack or 
cause it to miss.
Serene Spirit
Effect: The Triggering Attack has a bonus to Effect 
Ranges equal to your Tier Level and is treated as 
having the Spirit Surge Keyword, but it cannot 
become a Critical Hit. 
Warped Energy
Effect: Targets hit by the Triggering Attack subtract 
their Defense during Damage calculations instead of 
Special Defense. 
Amplified Sorcery
Effect: The Attack’s area of Effect is increased by +1. If 
it is 1-Target, it instead becomes Ranged Blast 2. 
Berserk Blast
Effect: The Triggering Attack has a bonus to Critical Hit 
Ranges equal to your Tier Level but its Effect Ranges 
are ignored. 
Channeled Element
Effect: Choose an adjacent willing Pokemon and one 
of their Types. The Triggering Attack is treated as that 
Type instead. The chosen Pokemon cannot apply 
Evasion against the next Attack that Targets them. 
Controlled Sorcery
Effect: The Triggering Attack gains the Friendly 
Keyword but it cannot deal Super Effective Damage 
via Type Effectiveness.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.130)
body:
130130
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
AURA GUARDIAN
The nature of Aura is the very spirit or life force of a creature, 
exhibited by both Pokemon and Humans. Aura Guardians can harness 
this energy and see it. Using this energy they can bolster the power of 
their allies or give restorative energy to those who are injured. 
Aura Guardian
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Occult Researcher or Mystic [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Occult Edu or Intuition, Novice Focus
Static 
Effect: Choose two of Aura Blast, Detect, Force Bullet, or 
Vacuum Wave. You learn the chosen Attacks. When you have 
4 Aura Guardian Features, choose two of Aura Burst, Aura 
Sphere, Focus Blast or Heal Pulse. You learn the 
chosen Attacks.
Aura Reading
Prerequisite: Aura Guardian, Novice Occult Edu or 
Intuition, Novice Focus
Static 
Effect: You gain the Aura Reader Capability. When 
you have Expert Occult Edu or Focus, choose either 
the Blindsense, Empath, Telepath or Tremorsense 
Capability to gain. Whenever you sense that a 
Combatant has negative intentions, you have a Boon 
to Skill Checks against them or opposed by them.
Ambient Aura
Prerequisite: Aura Guardian, Adept Occult Edu or 
Intuition, Novice Focus
At-Will - Free Action 
Trigger: You use an Attack with the Aura Keyword or 
an Ally within 5 m rolls a Natural 15+ on any d 20 
Effect: You gain an Aura Counter (Max 6). If the 
Triggering Attack was a Double Strike or Five Strike, it 
can only trigger this Feature once.
Bonus: Aura Counters may be expended in any of the 
following ways

• When you or an Ally perform an Accuracy or Save 
Check, as a Reaction, you may expend Aura Counters 
to grant it a bonus equal to your Tier Level for each 
Counter expended. If the roll fails, you gain your 
Reaction back.

• On your Turn, you may use a Swift Action to Target 
yourself or an Ally within 3 m. The Target restores 
Ticks of Hit Points equal to the number of Aura 
Counters expended. This may also be used as a 
Reaction when an Ally within 3 m ends their Turn, but 
it must Target them. 
Sacrificial Shield
Prerequisite: Ambient Aura, Expert Occult Edu or Intuition, 
Adept Focus
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: You or an Ally use the Intercept Maneuver
Effect: You may expend any number of Aura Counters to alter 
the Attack that the Triggering Combatant is Intercepting in 
the following ways, which may stack if multiple instances are 
applied:

• 1 Counter: The Attack is resisted by an additional Damage 
Step, up to Resisted.

• 1 Counter: The Effect Range no longer Triggers or is no 
longer a Critical Hit. 
Unleashed Aura
Prerequisite: Ambient Aura, Master Occult Edu or Intuition, 
Adept Focus
Scene x 2 - Swift Action 
Trigger: You use a Damaging Aura Attack
Effect: You may expend any number of Aura Counters and it 
benefits from the following effects based on the number you 
expended:

• 1+: The Attack’s DB is increased by double the number of 
Aura Counters expende.

• 2+: Targets cannot apply Physical or Special Evasion against 
them. 

• 3+: Its Critical Hit Range is increased by +2 and it gains the 
Smite Keyword or Sureshot if it already had Smite.
Note: The rate an Aura Guardian gains Aura Counters improves 
greatly depending on how manny allies they have. Feel free to adjust 
how often this occurs based on your table

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.131)
body:
131131
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
Some Trainers gain the supernatural ability to feel the emotions of 
others around them, including a special connection to Pokemon. Much 
like Yellow in the manga series, Empaths have the power to connect to 
others on a deep level, which allows for a total synchronized pair. 
EMPATH
Empath
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Occult Researcher or Mystic [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Intuition
Bind X - Free Action 
Target: A Creature within 20 m
Effect: While a Target is bound by this Feature they become 
Channeled by you. If the Target is unwilling you must make 
an Intuition Checks opposed by their Focus Check to Bind this 
Feature to them. You may stop Channeling any Target as a 
Free Action at any time. If a Channeled Combatant would go 
further than 20 m away from you they stop being Channeled. 
You are always considered a Channeled Combatant. You may 
only use this Feature on an Enemy once per Round. X is equal 
to the higher of your Intuition or Occult Edu Rank. 
Bonus: You gain the Empath Capability.
Soothing Pulse
Prerequisite: Empath, Adept Intuition
At-Will - Swift Action or Reaction
Trigger: A Channeled Combatant gains Initiative
Effect: Choose one of the following Effects to apply to 
the Triggering Combatant. 

• The Combatant restores two Ticks of Hit Points

• The Combatant has a bonus to their next Save Check 
equal to your Tier Level

• The Combatant has a Damage Penalty to their 
Damaging Attacks this Turn equal to your Tier Value.
Battle Bond
Prerequisite: Empath, 3 Empath Features, Master 
Intuition
Static
Effect: Whenever your Pokemon develop a deep bond 
with you at your GM’s Discretion, they become Battle 
Bonded. Battle Bonded Pokemon are always treated 
as Channeled regardless of distance and don’t count 
towards your limit of Channeled Combatants. At any 
point, you can use Battle Bond Techniques, but each time 
you use it, it will cost SP from an Active Battle Bonded 
Pokemon or yourself. 
Battle Bond Powers are on the next page
Twisted Emotions
Prerequisite: Empath, Novice Intuition
At-Will - Special 
Target: A Channeled Enemy
Effect: As a Full Action, choose a Status Affliction or 
Condition to grant the Enemy listed below. If Entranced 
or Provoked are chosen you may choose their Fixation 
or Provoker respectively. If Provoked is granted this way 
it lasts until the end of the Target’s next Turn. An Enemy 
can only have one Status Affliction granted this way at a 
time. As a Swift Action, if the Target has a listed Affliction 
or Condition below, you may cure it and inflict a different 
Affliction or Condition listed below. 

• Dazed, Enraged, Entranced, Provoked, Suppressed. 
Shared Conduit
Prerequisite: Empath, 2 Empath Features, Expert Intuition
Scene - Free Action
Target: Two Channeled Combatants that are within 2 m of 
each other
Effect: Apply one of the following Effects. If both Targets 
are Allies, this doesn’t expend this Feature’s Frequency. 

• Choose a Stat. Both Targets trade the CS Values for that 
Stat.

• Choose a Target to remove a Coat from and grant to the 
other Target.

• Choose a Target to gain all the Mental Afflictions that the 
other Target is suffering from.
Mechanic - Channeling
While Channeling a Creature, it may communicate its intentions, 
emotions and motivations to you and you may communicate in 
a similar fashion, neither party being able to be deceitful in this 
exchange. If you Faint, all Targets bound by the Empath Feature are 
unbound and no longer Channeled. If a Channeled Target Faints, they 
are unbound by the Empath Feature and no longer Channeled. As 
a general note, Channeling allows both individuals to be treated 
as having the Empath Capability, removes any risk of falsity 
and communicates more than just emotions

title: Symbiotic Defender
body:
Symbiotic Defender
Cost: 1 SP
Effect: The Battle Bonded Pokemon may use the 
Intercept Maneuver as a Free Action and it doesn’t 
increase by one damage step. If they spend 2 SP 
instead, or if you’re the one they’re intercepting for, 
the Attack is additionally resisted by an additional 
step. 
Symbiotic Retaliation
Cost: 1 SP 
Effect: When you or a Battle Bonded Pokemon are hit 
with an Attack, the other gains the Sureshot Keyword 
on their next Attack against the Triggering Enemy. 
Symbiotic Unity
Cost: 1 SP 
Effect: Whenever you use an Attack, you may shift its 
type to match one of the Bonded Pokemon’s Types. 
If you have the Elemental Affinity Talent or a Type 
Specialist Class, the Bonded Pokemon may also use 
this to shift an Attack they use to that Type. 
Symbiotic Strike
Cost: 1 SP 
Effect: You or your Battle Bonded Pokemon may learn 
an Attack from the other’s Attack List until the end of 
the Scene. If the Attack is not At-Will or Eo T, it costs 2 
SP instead. 
Symbiotic Resilience
Cost: 2 SP 
Effect: When you are hit with an Attack, you may use 
this Technique to treat your Type as being the same 
as your Battle Bonded Pokemon’s Type, in regards to 
Type Effectiveness Calculations. 
Symbiotic Senses
Cost: 1 SP 
Effect: Until the end of the Scene, you and the 
Bonded Pokemon share all of the following 
Capabilities if one or the other has it. Aura Reader, 
Blindsense, Darkvision, Dream Reader, Premonition, 
Soul Seer, Tracker, True Sight, Tremorsense, X-Ray 
Vision

Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
Psionic Prowess
Prerequisite: Esper, Novice Focus or Occult Edu 
Static 
Effect: Choose a Capability to gain along with the 
associated Attack in its parenthesis. 

• Dream Reader (Dream Illusion), Empath (Psycho 
Shift), Mender (Heal Pulse), Mindlock (Calm Mind), 
Mind Weaver (Disable), Premonition (Mind Reader), 
Telepath (Imprison), Telekinetic (Telekinesis), 
Teleporter (Teleport), Wallshaper (Barrier)
Mental Shield
Prerequisite: Esper, Expert Focus or Occult Edu
Scene x 2 - Reaction
Trigger: You or an Ally within 3 m gain a Mental 
Affliction or are hit with a Special Category Attack
Effect: If the Trigger was gaining a Mental Affliction, 
the Triggering Combatant automatically passes their 
next Save Check. If the Trigger was being hit by a 
Special Category Attack, you may use your Special 
Attack Stat towards Damage Calculations instead of 
the Triggering Combatant’s Special Defense. 
PK Force
Prerequisite: Esper, Adept Focus or Occult Edu
Scene x 2 - Swift Action 
Trigger: You resolve a Psychic Type Attack on your Turn that 
Targets an Enemy 
Effect: Apply one of the Effects below:

• All Targets Slide up to 3 m in any direction away from you.

• All Targets lose -2 CS in Special Defense, or -3 if it is positive.

• You may perform a Disarm, Hinder or Trip Maneuver as a 
Free Action against all Targets hit by the Triggering Attack, 
ignoring range. When performing the opposed roll, you 
must use either Focus or Occult Edu. An Enemy can only be 
affected by this Effect once per Scene. 
Metaphysical Mastery
Prerequisite: Psionic Prowess, Master Focus or Occult Edu 
Static 
Effect: Choose two of Psycho Boost, Psycho Slash, Psionic 
Boost or Mirror Coat. You learn the chosen Attacks. In 
addition, you gain another Capability from the Psionic 
Prowess Feature and its associated Attack. 
Esper
[Advanced] [Class]
Prerequisite 1: Occult Researcher or Mystic [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Focus, Novice Occult Edu
Static 
Effect: Choose two of Cognition Strike, Hypnosis, Psybeam, or 
Psychic Terrain. You learn the chosen Attacks. When you have 
4 Esper Features, choose two of Psycho Cut, Psychic, Psychic 
Storm or Psionic Surge. You learn the chosen Attacks. 
Trainers who are experts in the art of mysticism can sometimes have 
psychic abilities similar to Pokemon. These manifest in many different 
techniques, including the ability for telekinessis, telepathy or even 
teleporting! Espers excels in the variety of these psionic talents. 
ESPER
Artist: Cezaria

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.134)
body:
134134
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
MARKSMAN
Experts in keeping their distance and firing from afar, Marksman 
Trainers excel in ranged combat. Whether by using a bow, gun, or 
simply throwing fireballs from the backline, Marksmen are masters as 
precision, accuracy and staying far away from potential trouble. 
Marksman
[Base] [Class] 
Prerequisite: Novice Combat or Perception 
At-Will - Free Action 
Trigger: You miss a 1-Target Ranged Attack 
Effect: Your next 1-Target Ranged Attack gains all of the 
following benefits upon the Attack’s declaration. 

• It gains a bonus to Critical Hit Ranges equal to your Tier 
Level.

• Targets may only apply Speed Evasion against it.

• It gains the Unstoppable Keyword.
Cover Fire
Prerequisite: Marksman, Adept Combat or Perception
At-Will - Free Action 
Condition: You have a Ranged Weapon Equipped or know a 
Ranged Damaging Attack
Effect: Create a Zone consisting of up to 4 connecting spaces 
that are unoccupied within 5 m. Whenever an Enemy would 
enter one of these spaces you may Trigger an Attack of 
Opportunity, ignoring Range. This Zone is removed when you 
use a Movement Action or Reaction. You can only have one 
Zone created this way on the Field at a time.
Dead-Eye Shot
Prerequisite: Marksman, 3 Marksman Features, Master 
Combat or Perception
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: You use a Ranged Attack 
Effect: Perform the Accuracy Roll twice, taking either result. 
If both results would have hit one of their Targets, they resist 
it one step less to a maximum of Neutral Effectiveness and it 
gains the Unstoppable Keyword.
Clear Shot
Prerequisite: Marksman, Novice Combat or 
Perception
Static 
Effect: Whenever you use a 1-Target Ranged Attack 
against an Enemy that is adjacent to no other 
Combatants, they’re treated as Vulnerable against 
it. If they’re already Vulnerable, it instead gains the 
Sureshot Keyword. 
Modified Ammo
Prerequisite: Marksman, 2 Marksman Features, 
Expert Combat or Perception
Bind 1 - Swift Action 
Condition: You have a Ranged Weapon Equipped or 
know a Ranged Damaging Attack
Effect: When this Feature is bound, choose an Effect 
below to apply to all Damaging Ranged Attacks you 
use this Scene while bound. At the end of the Scene, 
this Feature is Unbound.

• Armor-Piercing - Before Damage calculations, the 
Targets lose -1 CS in the associated Defense Stat. On a 
16+ they instead lose -2 CS.

• Barbed - On a 16+, the Target becomes Slowed or 
gains the Wounded Affliction of your choice. 

• Distracting - On a Hit, the Target has a -2 Penalty to 
their next Accuracy Check. On a miss, it is instead a -3 
Penalty.

• Explosive - Any Single Target Ranged Weapon 
Attacks become Ranged Blast 3 instead, however 
all Targets that aren’t in the center space resist an 
additional damage step. 
Note - When taking this Class you need to have a few 
Ranged Attacks learned. This can be gained through 
other classes that grant Ranged Attacks or primarily 
with Ranged Weapons. 
Artist: @Royalnoir

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.135)
body:
135135
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
ARTILLERIST
Some Marksmen are experts at wide scale destruction, opting for the 
battle style of a cannon. Artillerists specialize in wide range attacks 
and raining down pain onto enemies, being able to make projected 
attacks and zones by which enemies get hurt if they cross its path. 
Artillerist 
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Marksman [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Focus or Perception
Bind X - Extended Action
Target: A Ranged Blast Attack, Line Attack or a Damaging 
1-Target Attack on your Attack list. 
Effect: While this Feature is Bound, the Targeted Attack’s 
Range improves. If it was a 1-Target Attack, it becomes 
Ranged Blast 2. If it was Ranged Blast, increase its Area of 
Effect by +1. If it was Line, increase its Area of Effect by +2. X 
is equal to the number of Artillerist Features you have.
 
Projected Barrage
Prerequisite: Artillerist, Novice Focus or Perception
At-Will - Swift or Movement Action
Trigger: The Round Starts
Effect: Choose a Line or Ranged Blast Attack and 
create a Zone that corresponds to its Range. At the 
end of the Round if the user hasn’t moved, the Attack 
is used as a Free Action, Targeting all Combatants in 
that Zone. (Frequency still applies)
Early Bombardment
Prerequisite: Projected Barrage, Expert Focus or 
Perception
At-Will - Reaction
Trigger: An Enemy enters your Zone created by the 
Projected Barrage Feature
Effect: The chosen Attack is immediately used as a 
Free Action, Targeting all Combatants in that Zone, 
however they resist it by an additional Damage Step. 
After this Attack resolves, the Triggering Enemy may 
continue any movement that was interrupted by this 
Feature. The corresponding Zone is then removed 
from the Field and Projected Barrage’s Effect does not 
resolve. 
Sieging Strike
Prerequisite: Artillerist, Adept Focus or Perception
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: You use a Line or Ranged Damaging Attack
Effect: Choose one of the Effects to apply to the 
Triggering Attack. 

• If the Triggering Attack was made through Projected 
Barrage, it gains the Sureshot Keyword.

• All Terrain within this Range are changed to Slow Terrain 
and all Blocking or Cover Terrain are destroyed.

• It ignores all positive Combat Stages in Defense or Special 
Defense.
Precision Strike
Prerequisite: Artillerist, 3 Artillerist Features, Master Focus or 
Perception
Scene - Swift Action 
Trigger: You use a Line or Ranged Blast Attack
Effect: Choose one of the Effects to apply to the 
Triggering Attack. 

• It gains the Friendly Keyword

• It gains the Sureshot Keyword
Bonus: Whenever you use the Artillerist Feature on a 1-Target 
Damaging Attack, you may also have it become a Line X 
Attack, where X is the range of the 1-Target Attack.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.136)
body:
136136
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
GUNSLINGER
Gunslingers dont’ need to literally have a gun, but they’re simply 
marksmen that specialize in close range combat. Their nimble nature 
allows them to bob and weave and get close up in combat, blasting 
enemies with whatever projectiles they’re trained in up close. 
Gunslinger 
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Marksman [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Acrobatics or Intuition 
Static 
Effect: Whenever you use a 1-Target Ranged Attack, you have 
a bonus to Accuracy equal to X subtracted by Y (Even if it’s 
Range would change as a result of a Feature). X is equal to 
the higher of your Acrobatics or Intuition Rank. Y is equal to 
the distance in Meters the Target is away from you.
Notet: If the result is negative, you don’t have a penalty, 
simply no modifier.
Fan the Hammer
Prerequisite: Gunslinger, Novice Acrobatics or 
Intuition 
At-Will - Swift Action 
Trigger: You use a 1-Target Ranged Attack
Effect: You may change the range of this Attack to 
Close Blast 2 or Burst 1. When you have at least 4 
Gunslinger Features, you may also change the range 
to Close Blast 3 or 3, 2 Targets. 
Quick Draw 
Prerequisite: Gunslinger, 2 Gunslinger Features, 
Expert Acrobatics or Intuition
Scene - Special
Trigger: You’re Targeted with an Attack
Effect: Before the Triggering Attack is used, you 
may use an Attack with the only Target being the 
Triggering Enemy. If the Triggering Enemy would faint 
as a result, the Triggering Attack no longer resolves. 
If this is used as a Reaction, the Attack must be a 
Basic Attack, then the Frequency of this Feature is not 
expended. If this is used as a Standard Action, it can 
be any 1-Target Ranged Damaging Attack.
Trick Shot
Prerequisite: Gunslinger, Adept Acrobatics or Intuition
Scene x 2 - Swift Action 
Trigger: You use a 1-Target Ranged Attack
Effect: Choose an Effect below to apply to the Triggering 
Attack

• The Triggering Attack gains the Unstoppable Keyword. The 
Target must be within 2 m of Cover or Blocking Terrain to 
choose this Effect. 

• Enemies that are Adjacent to the Target of the Triggering 
Attack also become a Target but the Attack is resisted by an 
additional Damage Step. 

• You may use the Triggering Attack to Target an Enemy that 
is illegal to Targeting due to line of sight breaking, The Target 
must be within 2 m of cover or Blocking Terrain that is within 
Range and Line of sight to use this Effect.
Rapid Fire Shot
Prerequisite: Gunslinger, 3 Gunslinger Features, Master 
Acrobatics or Intuition
Scene - Full Action 
Effect: You may perform a 1-Target Ranged Damaging Attack 
as a Free Action. This Attack can only have one Target and 
cannot Trigger any other Features. When using this Attack, 
perform the Accuracy Check 6 times. Each additional time 
it would hit the Target after the first, increase the DB by +3. 
Each time one of the Accuracy Rolls misses, the Target or an 
Enemy that is Adjacent to them becomes Wounded.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.137)
body:
137137
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
SNIPER
Compared to Gunslingers, Snipers are the oppose. These Trainers 
specialize in combat from afar, as far as possible from the safest and 
most secure position. They specialize in controlling zones, impairing 
enemies and having high precision with deadly results. 
Sniper
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Marksman [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Focus or Perception
At-Will - Special
Effect: This Feature can be used as a Swift Action, Movement 
Action or Reaction. Each time this Feature is used, add an 
Accuracy and Critical Hit modifier to your next Ranged Attack 
equal to your Tier Level. These bonuses are removed at the 
end of the Round. 
Targeted Strike
Prerequisite: Sniper, 2 Sniper Features, Expert Focus or 
Perception
Scene x 2 - Swift Action 
Trigger: You hit a 1-Target Ranged Damaging Attack 
Effect: Choose one of the following Effects to apply after the 
Triggering Attack’s Resolution. An Enemy can only be affected 
by Targeted Strike once per Scene:

• Head Shot - The Target becomes Blinded until the end of 
their next Turn.

• Chest Shot - The Target becomes Vulnerable until the end 
of the next Round.

• Arm Shot - The Target is treated as though they failed a 
Disarm Maneuver against the user.

• Leg Shot - The Target becomes Slowed.

• Wing Shot - The Target has all Movement Capabilities 
disabled until the end of the next Round.
Perfect Precision
Prerequisite: Sniper, 3 Sniper Features, Master Focus or 
Perception
Scene - Swift Action 
Condition: You have no Combatants within 2 m of you
Trigger: You use a 1-Target Ranged Attack against an Enemy 
with no Combatants adjacent to them
Effect: The Triggering Attack gains the Smite Keyword. If the 
Attack hits, it automatically becomes a Critical Hit. If it misses, 
the Frequency of this Feature isn’t expended.
Overwatch
Prerequisite: Sniper, Novice Focus or Perception
At-Will - Swift or Movement Action
Condition: You have a Ranged Weapon Equipped or 
know a Ranged Damaging Attack
Effect: Create a 3 x 3 Zone on the Field within 10 m of 
you that lasts until the start of your next Turn. This 
zone cannot overlap a Zone you’ve created through 
the Cover Fire Feature. Whenever an Enemy in this 
Zone performs any of the following, you may use a 
Basic Attack as a Free Action with Priority against 
them after the Trigger resolves, treating it as a 10 m, 
1 Target Attack. An Enemy can only be hit by a Basic 
Attack this way once per Round. 

• They use an Attack against an Ally that is not within 
that Zone or Adjacent to them.

• They enter a space outside of the Zone.
Trained Marksman
Prerequisite: Overwatch, Adept Focus or Perception
At-Will - Special
Condition: You have a Zone on the Field created by 
Overwatch
Trigger: An Enemy Party gains Initiative
Effect: You may move the Zone to anywhere else 
where it could legally be created. This Feature can 
be used as a Swift Action, Movement Action or or 
Reaction.
Bonus: You gain the Sniper Ability.
Artist: @Marceline Liu

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.138)
body:
138138
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
STRIDER
Experts of agility, Trainers who follow the path of a Strider specialize 
in the Speed Stat and their Advanced Classes focus on being nimble. 
Striders have the ability to use Speed for Damage, reacting to physical 
attacks sent their way and can even perform multiple Movement Actions. 
Strider
[Base] [Class] 
Prerequisite: Novice Acrobatics
Static 
Effect: Enemies cannot Trigger Reactions as a result of your 
Movement. You may learn two Attacks from the Nimble 
Combat Feature’s Novice Attack List.
Swift Striker
Prerequisite: Strider, Novice Acrobatics 
At-Will - Free Action, 
Trigger: You use a Damaging Physical Attack 
Effect: Choose one effect to apply. 

• You may use your Speed as an Offensive Stat 

• After the Attack’s Resolution, You may Move up to 
3 m. 

• All Targets cannot use their Speed Evasion against 
the Attack 
Nimble Tactics
Prerequisite: Strider, 2 Strider Features, Expert 
Acrobatics
Static
Effect: Choose a Nimble Tactic to gain its associated 
Ability in parenthesis. 

• Accelerating (Speed Boost), Agile (Alacrity), 
Evasive (Dodge), Swift (Rocket), Whirling (Lancer) 
Barely Grazed
Prerequisite: Strider, Adept Acrobatics 
Scene x 2 - Special 
Trigger: You’re hit with a Physical Attack
Effect: If this is used as a Reaction, you may use your 
Speed Stat instead of Defense when performing Damage 
Calculations. If this is used as a Free Action, you may use 
half of your Speed Stat instead of Defense when performing 
Damage Calculations and the Frequency of this Feature isn’t 
expended. 
Burst of Speed
Prerequisite: Strider, 3 Strider Features, Master Acrobatics
Scene x 2 - Swift Action + Reaction 
Effect: You gain an additional Standard Action. You become 
Vulnerable until the start of your next Turn. 
Bonus: The First time you would use a Movement Action 
each Round, it does not expend your Action.
Note - : Nimble Combat’s Novice Attack List is: 

•  Aerial Ace, Acrobatics, Agility, Quick Attack, Quick Strike, Splash

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.139)
body:
Evasion Token Note - You can spend multiple Evasion Tokens to downgrade an attack 
multiple times if desired. If an Attack is a normal hit, you can spend 2 Evasion Tokens to 
downgrade it to resisted, then because it’s resisted, it then misses. 
139139
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
ACROBAT
Trainers who are Acrobats take speed to the level of full Evasion. They 
excel at not being hit by attacks and if they’re ignored, helping their 
less nimble allies avoid the hit as well. Through Evasion tokens and 
their Features, they don’t need armor if they’re never hit.
Acrobat 
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Strider [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Acrobatics or Intuition
At-Will - Swift + Movement Action 
Effect: You gain an Evasion Token. 
Bonus: You start the Scene with 1 Evasion Token (Max 3). You 
may expend any number of Evasion Tokens when you’re hit 
by a non-Adjacent Damaging Attack to downgrade it. If it was 
a Critical Hit, it is instead a normal hit. If it was a normal hit, 
you resist it an additional step. If you resisted it, it instead 
misses. You cannot use Evasion Tokens if you have Damage 
Reduction from any Item you’re holding or equipping.
Sidestep
Prerequisite: Acrobat, Novice Acrobatics or Intuition
Scene - Free Action 
Trigger: You’re hit by a Line, Burst or Blast Attack 
Effect: You may slide 1 m into an unoccupied space. 
If you are no longer in the original range of the 
Triggering Attack, it instead misses you. You may 
expend an Evasion Token when using this Feature to 
slide an additional 1 m or not expend the Frequency 
of Sidestep. 
Acrobatic Reflex
Prerequisite: Acrobat, 2 Acrobat Features, Expert 
Acrobatics or Intuition 
Scene x 2 - Special 
Trigger: You’re hit by a Ranged 1-Target Attack 
Effect: You may slide into an Adjacent unoccupied 
space. If you do, the Triggering Attack instead misses. 
This Feature is a Standard Action, but if you expend 1 
Evasion Token it may be used as a Movement Action 
or Reaction instead.
Look out! 
Prerequisite: Acrobat, Adept Acrobatics or Intuition
At-Will - Reaction
Trigger: An Ally within 2 m would be hit by an Attack 
Effect: The Triggering Ally is treated as having access to your 
Acrobat Features and current Evasion Tokens and may expend 
their usage until the Attack resolves. 
Bob and Weave
Prerequisite: Acrobat, 3 Acrobat Features, Master Acrobatics 
or Intuition
Static 
Effect: You may use Evasion Tokens against Adjacent 
Damaging Attacks. The Acrobat Feature’s Action usage 
instead becomes Swift or Movement Action. You cannot gain 
more than two Evasion Tokens per Round.

title: Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes (p.140)
body:
140140
Chapter 4 - Trainer Classes
DANCER
The spirit of dancing can take many forms, from the nimble 
movements of a pirate to a shrine maiden performing sacred arts. 
Dancers specialize in utilizing their Movement Action for more than 
just movement, allowing them to dance in place and impact the field. 
Dancer 
[Advanced] [Class] 
Prerequisite 1: Performer or Strider [or]
Prerequisite 2: Adept Acrobatics and Novice Charm or Guile
Static 
Effect: Choose two Basic Dance Technique to learn. All Dance 
Techniques performed by you or your Pokemon can only 
Target the same Combatant once per Round. 
Signature Performance
[Ranked 2]
Rank 1 Prerequisite: Dancer, Novice Acrobatics and 
Novice Charm or Guile 
Rank 2 Prerequisite: Dancer, 3 Dancer Features, 
Master Acrobatics and Adept Charm or Guile 
Static 
Rank 1 Effect: Choose two Basic Dance Techniques on 
the next page to learn. 
Rank 2 Effect: Choose two Basic Dance Techniques 
or one Signature Dance Technique listed on the next 
page to learn. 
Dance Technqiues are on the next page
Choreographer
Prerequisite: Dancer, Adept Acrobatics, Novice Charm 
or Guile 
At-Will- Extended Action 
Trigger: You perform a Training Downtime Action on your 
Pokemon who has at least Proficient Acrobatics and doesn’t 
know a Dance Technique
Effect: Choose a non-Signature Dance Technique you learned. 
The Target also learns that Technique. 
Captivated Audience 
Prerequisite: Dancer, 2 Dancer Features, Expert Acrobatics 
and Adept Charm or Guile 
Scene x 2 - Free Action 
Trigger: You use a Dance that Targets an Enemy 
Effect: Choose one effect to apply to the Target. Each Enemy 
can only be affected this way once per Scene. 

• Any Status Affliction they gain as a result can’t be cured 
during their next Save Check

• They suffer a Bane to their next opposed Skill Check

• Their Positive Combat Stages are set to their Default Value

title: Basic Dance Techniques
body:
Basic Dance Techniques
Beguiling Rhythm
At-Will - Swift or Movement Action
Target: An Enemy within 5 m 
Effect: Choose a Stat for the Target to lose -2 CS in.
Charming Serenade
At-Will - Swift or Movement Action
Target: An Enemy within 5 m
Effect: You may perform the Distract or Intrigue Maneuver against the 
Target as a Free Action. You may use your choice of Charm or Guile instead 
of listed skills on the Maneuver. 
Duet’s Momentum
Scene x 2 - Reaction or Movement Action
Trigger: You and an Ally gain Initiative
Effect: The Ally gains a bonus to Accuracy Rolls and Save Checks equal to 
your Tier Level until the end of this Initiative.
Evasive Footwork
Static
Effect: You gain Evasion equal to your Tier Level.
Invigorating Performance
At-Will - Swift or Movement Action
Target: An Ally within 3 m
Effect: Choose Accuracy Rolls or Save Checks. The Target gains a bonus to 
their next Roll of that Type equal to your Tier Level.
Motivating Performance
At-Will - Swift or Movement Action
Target: An Ally within 3 m
Effect: Choose a Stat for the Target to gain +1 CS in.
Performer’s Stamina
At-Will - Free Action
Trigger: You use an Action on a Dance Technique or move as a Movement 
Action
Effect: You gain a Tick of Temporary Hit Points or a bonus to your next Save 
Check equal to your Tier Level.
Solo Performer
Static
Effect: Anytime you use a Dance that would Target an Ally, you may instead 
Target Yourself. 
Taunting Flourish
At-Will - Swift or Movement Action
Target: An Enemy within 3 m
Effect: The Target becomes Trapped by you. You may make a Command or 
Guile Check opposed by their Focus. If you succeed they become Provoked 
by you until the end of their next Turn.
Thrilling Performance
At-Will - Swift or Movement Action
Target: An Ally within 3 m
Effect: Perform an Acrobatics, Charm or Guile Check. The Ally gains a 
bonus to their next Damage Roll equal to the result. 
 
Signature Dance 
Techniques
Dance of Devotion
Scene- Movement Action
Trigger: An Adjacent Ally is Targeted by an 
Attack
Effect: You may use an Intercept 
Maneuver as a Free Action. You have 
Damage Reduction against it equal to 
triple your Acrobatics Rank.
Dance of Elegance
Scene - Swift or Movement Action
Effect: Perform a Charm or Guile Check 
opposed by all Enemies within 3 m and 
their Focus Check. Each Enemy that fails 
becomes Vulnerable until the end of the 
next Round.
Dance of Elements
Scene - Swift or Movement Action
Target: Two Allies within 5 m, one being a 
Pokemon
Effect: During this Scene, the second 
Target may use Damaging Attacks as if it’s 
Type was one of the Types belonging to 
the first Target. 
Dance of Life
Scene - Swift or Movement Action
Target: An Ally within 3 m
Effect: The Target is cured of a Status 
Affliction. 
Dance of Spirits
Scene - Swift or Movement Action
Target: An Enemy within 5 m
Effect: Perform a Charm or Guile Check 
opposed by their Focus. If you succeed, 
the Target becomes Cursed or Suppressed
Dance of War
Scene - Swift or Movement Action
Target: An Ally within 3 m
Effect: The Target’s next Damaging Attack 
has a +2 bonus to Crit Range and gains the 
Smite Keyword. 
DANCE TECHNIQUES
